title: 桐壺
summary: 帝（桐壺帝）は身分が高くない桐壺更衣を深く寵愛し皇子を儲けるが、更衣は周囲の激しい嫉妬に苦しみ病死する。深く悲嘆に暮れる帝を慰めるため、亡き更衣に生き写しの藤壺が入内し寵愛を得る。皇子は亡き母の面影を残す藤壺を慕いながら育ち、元服を迎えて臣籍降下し「源」の姓を賜る。その輝く美貌から光源氏と呼ばれるようになり、左大臣の娘・葵の上の婿に迎えられる。
gendaibun: どの帝の御代であったか、女御や更衣たちが大勢お仕えしている中に、たいして高い身分ではないのに、とりわけて帝の寵愛を一身に集めている人があった。最初から自分こそはと思い上がっていた宮廷の御方々は、これを目ざわりなものとねたみ、憎んだ。
gendaibunen: In the reign of a certain emperor, among the many consorts and ladies in waiting who served at court, there was one of no particularly exalted rank who enjoyed his favor above all others. Those ladies who had considered themselves of the first importance looked upon her with contempt and bitter jealousy.
kobun: いづれの御時にか、女御、更衣あまたさぶらひたまひける中に、いとやむごとなき際にはあらぬが、すぐれて時めきたまふありけり。はじめより我はと思ひ上がりたまへる御方々、めざましきものにおとしめ嫉みたまふ。
kobunen: In the reign of a certain Emperor, among the many Ladies of the Wardrobe and Intimates who served at court, there was one who, though not of exalted rank, was favored above all others. Those ladies who had considered themselves superior looked on her with dismay and envy.

scene.content: 桐壺更衣、玉のような皇子(源氏)を抱いて帝の前に進む。
scene.contenten: Lady Kiritsubo carries the jewel-like prince (Genji) before the Emperor.

scene.content: 桐壺更衣の死後の秋の夜、靫負命婦、帝の命により更衣の里邸にその母を見舞い、帝の文を奉る。
scene.contenten: On an autumn night after Lady Kiritsubo's death, Yuge no Myobu visits the lady's mother by the Emperor's order and delivers his letter.

scene.content: 鴻臚館にて高麗の相人、源氏の相を見る。 右大弁同伴する。
scene.contenten: At the Korokan, a Korean physiognomist reads Genji's features, accompanied by Udaiben.

scene.content: 清涼殿東廂にて源氏元服の儀式。 左大臣加冠の役を務める。
scene.contenten: Genji's coming-of-age ceremony at the east wing of the Seiryoden; the Minister of the Left performs the cap-setting.

scene.content: 源氏の加冠の禄として左大臣に帝より物を賜う。
scene.contenten: The Emperor bestows gifts on the Minister of the Left as reward for Genji's cap-setting.

summaryen: The Kiritsubo Emperor deeply favors Lady Kiritsubo, a woman of modest rank, who bears him a radiant prince but soon dies of grief under relentless court jealousy. To console the Emperor, Princess Fujitsubo enters court as a living likeness of the late lady, and the young prince comes to revere her dearly. Upon his coming of age, the prince is given the Minamoto surname and takes Lady Aoi as his wife.

title: 帚木
summary: 五月雨の降る夜、宮中に宿直する源氏のもとに頭中将・左馬頭・藤式部丞が集まり、女性論を交わす「雨夜の品定め」を行う。翌日、方違えのため訪れた中川の紀伊守邸で、源氏は伊予介の後妻・空蝉の気配に惹かれ、夜忍び込んで契りを結ぶ。源氏は空蝉の弟・小君を手なずけて文を送るが、空蝉は自らの身分をわきまえ、源氏の執拗な求愛を拒み続ける。
gendaibun: 光る源氏という名は、たいそう大げさで、実際以上に美化された名だけが世に喧伝されているようなところもあるのに、ましてこのような好色めいた色恋沙汰などを後世にまで言い伝えられて、浮気な名を残すことになってはと、身を慎んで忍んでおられた隠し事までを語り伝えた人の口の軽さこそ憎らしい。
gendaibunen: The name Shining Genji was perhaps far too grand, with his reputation exalted beyond reality; yet how malicious was the gossip of those who handed down even the secret escapades he carefully concealed, fearing that whispers of his amorous pursuits might reach future generations and taint his name with frivolous gallantry.
kobun: 光る源氏、名のみことことしう、言ひ消たれたまふ咎多かなるに、いとど、かかる好きごとどもを、末の世にも聞き伝へて、軽びたる名をや流さむと、忍びたまひける隠ろへごとをさへ、語り伝へけむ人のもの言ひさがなさよ。
kobunen: Shining Genji—his very name was imposing, and though there were many who criticized him unfairly, he took great care in his secret affairs lest later ages hear of such amorous adventures and cast him as fickle; yet how spitefully loose-tongued were those who passed down even his most hidden encounters.

scene.content: 五月雨の夜、源氏の宿直所を頭中将が訪問。 故ありげな消息などに興味を示す。そこへ左馬頭、藤式部丞が加わり女性論議 (雨夜の品定め)。
scene.contenten: On a rainy night in May, To no Chujo visits Genji's night quarters and takes interest in mysterious letters; Sama no Kami and Toshikibu no Jo join a debate on women (the rainy-night ranking).

scene.content: 左馬頭の体験談 女を訪ねるある殿上人に同行したところ簀子に腰掛けて笛を吹く男がいた。 御簾の内より琴を合わせる女はかつて左馬頭が通っていた女であった (木枯しの女)。
scene.contenten: Sama no Kami's tale: accompanying a courtier to a woman's house, they see a man playing a flute on the veranda; inside, a woman answers on the koto, once known to Sama no Kami.

scene.content: 源氏、 方違えで、 中川の紀伊守の邸に行き、歓待される。
scene.contenten: Avoiding an unlucky direction, Genji visits the Governor of Kii's residence at Nakagawa and is entertained.

scene.content: 中川の紀伊守邸に泊まった源氏、 空蝉の部屋をうかがう。従者たちは酔って仮寝。
scene.contenten: Staying at the Governor of Kii's mansion, Genji peers into Utsusemi's room; the attendants, drunk, fall asleep.

scene.content: 空蝉と一夜を明かした源氏、夜明けに空蝉を障子口まで送る。
scene.contenten: After a night with Utsusemi, Genji escorts her to the sliding door at dawn.

summaryen: On a rainy night during the summer rains, young nobles gather around Genji and engage in the famous debate ranking various classes of women. The following evening, Genji stays at the residence of the Governor of Kii to avoid an unlucky direction, where he discovers Utsusemi, wife of the Deputy Governor of Iyo, and forces an encounter. While Genji attempts to pursue her through her young brother Kogimi, Utsusemi steadfastly refuses to compromise her honor.

title: 空蝉
summary: 夏の夕暮れ、小君の手引きで再び紀伊守邸に忍び込んだ源氏は、空蝉と義理の娘・軒端荻が碁を打つ姿を垣間見る。夜になって源氏が寝所に忍び寄ると、気配を察した空蝉は薄衣一枚を残して脱ぎ捨て逃げ去る。源氏は残された軒端荻と一夜を共にするが、心は逃げた空蝉を忘れられず、脱ぎ捨てられた蝉の抜け殻のような薄衣を抱いて去る。
gendaibun: 寝つかれないままに、源氏は「自分はこれまで人に嫌われた経験などないのに、今夜初めて世の中のつらさを思い知らされた。恥ずかしくてとても生きてはいられない気がする」などと恨み言をおっしゃるので、小君は涙をこぼして添い寝していた。
gendaibunen: Unable to sleep, Genji lamented, 'Never before have I been treated with such disdain; tonight for the first time I have tasted the bitterness of this world, and feel so ashamed that I scarcely care to go on living.' Hearing this, Kogimi wept beside him.
kobun: 寝られたまはぬままには、「我は、かく人に憎まれてもならはぬを、今宵なむ、初めて憂しと世を思ひ知りぬれば、恥づかしくて、ながらふまじうこそ、思ひなりぬれ」などのたまへば、涙をさへこぼして臥したり。
kobunen: Unable to sleep, Genji murmured, 'I am not accustomed to being scorned like this; tonight for the first time I have learned how painful the world can be, and feel so mortified that I doubt I can endure.' Kogimi lay weeping beside him in distress.

scene.content: 源氏、小君の手引きで中川の邸に忍び、空輝と軒端荻が碁をうつ姿を隙見する。
scene.contenten: Guided by Kogimi, Genji steals into the Nakagawa mansion and glimpses Utsusemi and Nokiba no Ogi playing go.

scene.content: 源氏、小君の手引きで空蟬と軒端荻とが共寝する部屋に忍び入る。
scene.contenten: Guided by Kogimi, Genji slips into the room where Utsusemi and Nokiba no Ogi sleep together.

scene.content: 忍び入る源氏に気付いた空蟬、部屋をすべりでる。
scene.contenten: Utsusemi, noticing Genji stealing in, slips out of the room.

scene.content: 空蝉と取り違えて軒端荻と一夜を共にした源氏、帰ろうとして、寝入っている小君を起こす。
scene.contenten: Genji, having spent the night with Nokiba no Ogi by mistake, wakes the sleeping Kogimi to leave.

scene.content: 源氏、 空蝉の脱ぎ捨てた薄い衣を取って侘しく部屋を出る。
scene.contenten: Genji takes the thin robe Utsusemi left behind and leaves the room forlornly.

summaryen: On a summer evening, guided by Kogimi, Genji steals into the mansion and peeks at Utsusemi playing go with her stepdaughter Nokiba no Ogi. Slipping into their bedchamber late at night, Genji is evaded by Utsusemi, who swiftly flees leaving only an unlined robe behind. Though Genji spends the night with Nokiba no Ogi, his thoughts remain captive to Utsusemi, taking her cast-off robe as a bittersweet souvenir.

title: 夕顔
summary: 源氏は病に伏せる乳母の見舞いに訪れた五条の陋屋の隣家で、可憐な夕顔の花と扇を差し出す薄幸の女（夕顔）と出会う。身元を隠したまま逢瀬を重ねるが、ある秋の夜、某の院に夕顔を連れ出したところ、六条御息所の生霊が現れて夕顔を取り殺してしまう。源氏は深い哀痛に打ちひしがれ、後に夕顔が親友・頭中将の失踪した側室であったことを知る。
gendaibun: 源氏が六条あたりへお忍びで通っておられたころ、御所からそこへ向かう途中で、重い病気にかかり出家した大弐の乳母を見舞おうとして、五条辺りにあるその家へ立ち寄られた。
gendaibunen: During the days when Genji was secretly visiting a certain lady around the Sixth Avenue district, he stopped on his way from the imperial palace to visit his nurse, the Daini no Menoto, who had fallen gravely ill and taken Buddhist vows at her house near Fifth Avenue.
kobun: 六条わたりの御忍び歩きのころ、内裏よりまかでたまふ道に、いと重き心地して、煩ふと聞きたまひて、大弐の乳母の、いたういたぢ敷き家に、立ち寄りたまへり。
kobunen: At the time of his secret wanderings around the Sixth Avenue quarter, Genji, hearing that his wet nurse the Daini lady was critically ill and suffering, stopped by her cramped and modest dwelling on his way from the imperial palace.

scene.content: 源氏、乳母の家の隣家の垣に咲く夕顔を随身に手折らすと、内より童女が出てきて、花を載せるための扇を差し出す。半蔀を上げたところより女たち、源氏の車を眺める。
scene.contenten: Genji has his attendant pick an evening glory blooming on the fence of his nurse's neighbor; a girl comes out and offers a fan to hold the flowers, while women watch his carriage from the raised shutter.

scene.content: 源氏、惟光に紙燭を持たせて扇をみると、女の移り香が染み、歌が書石の入道の娘の話など、供人たちが語るのを聞いた。
scene.contenten: Genji has Koremitsu bring a lamp; on the fan he finds the woman's lingering scent and a poem, and hears attendants tell of the daughter of the stone-weaving recluse.

scene.content: 六条御息所を訪れた翌朝、源氏、廊まで送りに出た中将の君を振り返りみて歌を交わす。 庭で侍童が朝顔を摘んでいる。
scene.contenten: The morning after visiting the Lady of Rokujo, Genji looks back at the Chujo no Kimi who saw him to the corridor and exchanges poems; a page picks morning glories in the garden.

scene.content: 夕顔の宿に泊まった源氏、変わらぬ愛を誓う。砧の音や祈る年老いた声などが聞こえる。
scene.contenten: Genji stays at Yugao's lodging and pledges unchanging love; he hears fulling mallets and an old woman's prayers.

summaryen: Visiting his sick nurse near Gojo, Genji notices evening glory blossoms on a modest fence and receives a fan inscribed with a poem from a mysterious woman (Yugao). They conduct a secret romance without disclosing their true identities, but during a night together at a deserted villa, the vengeful spirit of Lady Rokujo appears and strikes Yugao dead. Heartbroken, Genji later realizes that Yugao was the lost lover of his friend To no Chujo.

title: 若紫
summary: 瘧病（マラリア）の加療のため北山を訪れた源氏は、庵で藤壺に酷似した可憐な少女（若紫、後の紫の上）を垣間見る。少女を引き取りたいと申し出るが、祖母の尼君に断られる。京に戻った源氏は病で退出していた藤壺と密会を果たし、藤壺は源氏の子を懐妊する。冬、尼君が亡くなり身寄りをなくした若紫を、源氏は父・兵部卿宮に先んじて二条院へ引き取り、自らの手で理想の女性へと育て始める。
gendaibun: 源氏は瘧病にかかっておられた。いろいろとおまじないや加持祈祷などを試みさせられたが効き目がなく、たびたび発作がぶり返すので、ある人が北山の寺に高名な行者がいることを教え申し上げた。
gendaibunen: Genji had been suffering from an intermittent ague. Various incantations and prayers had been offered for his recovery without effect, and the fever returned again and again, until someone told him of a holy anchorite of great renown living in a monastery in the northern hills.
kobun: 瘧病にわづらひたまひて、よろづにまじなひ加持など参らせたまへど、しるしなくて、あまたたびおこりたまひければ、ある人、「北山になむ、なにがし寺といふ所に、かしこき行ひ人はべる」と聞こゆ。
kobunen: Suffering from ague, Genji had all manner of spells and prayers performed, but they proved unavailing and the attacks recurred repeatedly; whereupon someone reported to him, 'In the northern hills, at a certain temple, dwells a monk of great spiritual power.'

scene.content: 源氏、加持祈禱の暇々に、散策しながら景色を眺め、諸国の名勝や明石の入道の娘の話など、供人たちが語るのを聞いた。
scene.contenten: Between invocations Genji strolls and views the scenery, hearing his attendants speak of famous places and of the daughter of the Akashi recluse.

scene.content: 源氏、北山の僧都の坊で、逃げた雀を追って縁先に出た美少女(紫の上)を垣間見る。
scene.contenten: At the Bishop's monastery in Kitayama, Genji glimpses a beautiful girl (Murasaki) who comes to the veranda chasing an escaped sparrow.

scene.content: 源氏、一夜尼君の兄の僧都の坊を訪ね、少女の素性を聞く。庭には遣水を引き篝火をともして趣き深いようす。
scene.contenten: Genji visits the Bishop's monastery and asks about the girl's parentage; the garden, with its stream and bonfires, is deeply charming.

scene.content: 源氏、物思いに悩み眠れぬ。滝の音も強くなったように聞こえる。
scene.contenten: Genji lies awake troubled by longing; the sound of the waterfall seems to grow stronger.

scene.content: 左大臣の子息ら、源氏の迎えに来、僧都源氏とともに桜散る山中で酒宴、合奏。
scene.contenten: The Minister of the Left's sons come to fetch Genji; with the Bishop they feast and play music among the falling cherry blossoms.

scene.content: 帰京した尼君を見舞った源氏の声を聞きつけ、紫の君が尼君に会うようにと騒ぐのを女房らたしなめる。
scene.contenten: Hearing Genji's voice after he visits the nun upon returning to the capital, Murasaki clamors to see her, and the ladies restrain her.

scene.content: 尼君亡きあと、源氏は紫の君を訪ね、人見知りする少女を引き寄せ膝の上に休ませようとする。
scene.contenten: After the nun's death, Genji visits Murasaki and tries to take the shy girl onto his knee to rest.

scene.content: 源氏、二条院に引き取った紫の君とともに手習いや雛遊びをして過ごす。
scene.contenten: Genji lives at Nijo-in with Murasaki, amusing themselves with calligraphy and dolls.

summaryen: Seeking treatment for an intermittent fever in Kitayama, Genji glimpses a charming young girl (Wakamurasaki, later Murasaki no Ue) who bears an astonishing resemblance to Fujitsubo. After returning to the capital, Genji manages a tryst with Fujitsubo, leaving her pregnant. Following the death of the girl's grandmother the nun in winter, Genji takes the orphaned child to his Nijo mansion to raise her according to his ideals.

title: 末摘花
summary: 亡き常陸宮の遺児が荒れ果てた邸で孤独に暮らしていると聞き、好奇心を抱いた源氏と頭中将は競って言い寄る。源氏が先んじて契りを結ぶが、後朝の雪の朝に改めて見た彼女は、座高が高く痩せ細り、紅花で染めたように鼻先が赤く垂れ下がった不器量な姫君（末摘花）であった。幻滅しながらも、その誠実で古風な人柄を見捨てられない源氏は、以後も終生援助を続ける。
gendaibun: 源氏は若紫を二条院の二の対へお迎えになって、この上なく大切に育てておられたが、まだ子どもの愛嬌にとどまり、本当の恋人としての相手にはならないので、物足りなく思われる折々には、さまざまな所へお便りをお出しになるのだった。
gendaibunen: Having brought Wakamurasaki to the Nijo mansion, Genji cherished her with tenderest care; yet she was still only a child, providing no companion for genuine love, and in his restless moments he continued to send letters in various directions.
kobun: 二条の院の東の対にしつらひて、迎へたてまつりたまひて、いといたうかしづききこえたまふ。幼き心地には、うつくしき人の添ひおはするを、いとうれしと思ひて、あくがれ歩きもしたまはず。
kobunen: Having arranged the eastern wing of his Nijo mansion, Genji received the young girl and cared for her devotedly; in her childish heart, she was overjoyed to have such a handsome guardian constantly beside her and ceased to long for anything else.

scene.content: 月の明るい夜、源氏、常陸宮邸を訪ね、命婦の手引きで姫君 (末摘花)の琴を聞く。庭前に紅梅。
scene.contenten: On a moonlit night Genji visits Hitachi no Miya's residence and, guided by a lady-in-waiting, hears the princess (Suetsumuhana) play the koto; red plum blossoms stand in the garden.

scene.content: 源氏、 常陸宮邸に忍ぶと、身をやつした姿ですでに来ていた頭中将を見いだす。邸内では末摘花、琴を弾く。
scene.contenten: Stealing into Hitachi no Miya's residence, Genji finds To no Chujo already there in disguise; inside, Suetsumuhana plays the koto.

scene.content: 二人は、一つ車で左大臣邸へ向かう。源氏、車の中で笛を吹く。
scene.contenten: The two share a carriage toward the Minister of the Left's residence; Genji plays the flute inside.

scene.content: 冬の夜、末摘花邸を訪ねた源氏が格子を叩くと、女房が灯をとって迎え入れる。
scene.contenten: On a winter night Genji visits Suetsumuhana's residence and knocks at the lattice; a lady-in-waiting brings a light to welcome him.

scene.content: 源氏、常陸宮邸の橘の木の雪を随身に払わせる。
scene.contenten: Genji has his attendant brush the snow off the orange tree at Hitachi no Miya's residence.

scene.content: 源氏、二条院に戻り、紫の君と絵を描き、さらに自分の鼻に紅を塗ってみて紫の君を驚かせる。
scene.contenten: Back at Nijo-in, Genji paints with Murasaki, then smears rouge on his own nose and startles her.

summaryen: Drawn by rumors of an orphaned princess living in seclusion in a decaying palace, Genji and To no Chujo compete to woo her. Genji succeeds in consummating the courtship, only to discover in the daylight of a snowy morning that she is remarkably plain, with a long nose dyed red like a safflower (Suetsumuhana). Despite his dismay, her naivety and antique fidelity touch Genji, and he promises lifelong care.

title: 紅葉賀
summary: 朱雀院への行幸で執り行われる上皇の長寿祝い（紅葉賀）を前に、宮中での試楽で源氏は頭中将とともに「青海波」を見事に舞い、藤壺を始め殿上人を感嘆させる。翌年二月、藤壺は源氏との密通による男子（後の冷泉帝）を出産。桐壺帝は自らの皇子と信じて疑わず溺愛し、源氏と藤壺は罪の意識と恐れに苛まれる。
gendaibun: 朱雀院の行幸は十月の十幾日ということになっていた。世の常の行幸とは違って、格別な興趣のあるはずの催しであったので、後宮の女御や更衣たちは見物できないのを口惜しがった。
gendaibunen: The imperial visit to the Suzaku Palace was fixed for past the tenth of the Tenth Month. Since it promised to be a splendid event far exceeding ordinary occasions, the ladies of the palace regretted that they would not be able to witness it.
kobun: 朱雀院の行幸は、神無月の十日あまりなり。世の常ならず、おもしろかるべきたびのことなりければ、御方々、物見たまはぬことを口惜しがりたまふ。主上も、藤壺の見たまはざらむを、飽かず思さるれば、試楽を御前にて、せさせたまふ。
kobunen: The imperial progress to Suzaku-in took place past the tenth day of the Tenth Month. Because it was an extraordinary and delightful celebration, the court ladies lamented that they could not view it; and the Emperor, reluctant to have Fujitsubo miss the spectacle, ordered a rehearsal in her presence.

scene.content: 朱雀院行幸の日、源氏、頭中将と青海波を舞う。
scene.contenten: On the day of the Suzaku-in imperial visit, Genji and To no Chujo dance the Seigaiha.

scene.content: 元旦、朝拝に参内する源氏、 雛遊びに熱中している紫の君のもとに立ち寄る。
scene.contenten: On New Year's Day Genji, attending court, stops by Murasaki, who is absorbed in playing with dolls.

scene.content: 藤壺との恋に悩む源氏、気晴らしに笛を吹きながら桂姿で紫の君の居間を覗く。 待ちくたびれた紫の君は不機嫌に横を向いている。
scene.contenten: Troubled by his love for Fujitsubo, Genji in a casual guise plays the flute and peeps into Murasaki's room; tired of waiting, she sulks and turns away.

scene.content: 源氏、機嫌をなおした紫の君に琴を教えたあと、灯火をつけて二人で絵を見る。
scene.contenten: After teaching a now-cheerful Murasaki the koto, Genji lights a lamp and the two look at pictures.

scene.content: 源氏、温明殿の辺りを歩き、琵琶を弾く源内侍と戯れる。
scene.contenten: Genji walks near the Unmeiden and frolics with Gen'nai no Naishi, who plays the biwa.

summaryen: Preparations are made for the retired Emperor's autumn festival at Suzaku Palace; during the rehearsal, Genji and To no Chujo dance 'Seigaiha' with peerless grace, astonishing the court. The following spring, Fujitsubo gives birth to a boy who is secretly Genji's child. The Kiritsubo Emperor, unaware of the truth, dotes on the infant as his own heir, plunging Genji and Fujitsubo into intense inner guilt.

title: 花宴
summary: 春の南殿の桜の宴で漢詩を詠じ舞を披露した源氏は、宴の果てた夜更け、弘徽殿の細殿で春の月を口ずさむ美女と行き逢い契りを結ぶ。扇を交換して別れたのち、右大臣邸の藤花の宴に招かれた源氏は、その女人こそ東宮（後の朱雀帝）へ入内を控えた右大臣の六の君・朧月夜であることを突き止め、再び情を通わせる。
gendaibun: 二月二十日過ぎに、南殿の桜の宴が催された。中宮と東宮のお席も左右に並び、帝のお出ましがあって、宴の儀式が始まった。
gendaibunen: Toward the end of the Second Month, a cherry blossom festival was held at the Southern Hall. The seats of the Empress and the Crown Prince were arranged to the left and right, and upon the Emperor's appearance, the ceremonial banquet commenced.
kobun: 如月の廿日あまり、南殿の桜の宴せさせたまふ。中宮、春宮の御桟敷、左右に立ち並びて、御幸あり。
kobunen: Past the twentieth of the Second Month, an imperial cherry blossom banquet was held at the Southern Hall. The seats of the Empress and the Crown Prince stood side by side to the left and right as the Emperor arrived.

scene.content: 桜花の宴の果てた月夜、源氏、弘徽殿の細殿で扇をかざして歩いてくる女朧月夜)に逢う。
scene.contenten: On a moonlit night after the cherry-blossom banquet, Genji meets a woman (Oborozukiyo) walking with a fan in the corridor of the Kokiden.

scene.content: 一夜を過ごした女は相手が源氏と知ってか、慌てず、二人は扇を取り換えて別れる。
scene.contenten: After the night, the woman stays calm even on learning her lover is Genji; the two exchange fans and part.

scene.content: 右大臣邸の藤花の宴に招かれた源氏、 花宴の夜の女を探し、女一宮、女三宮のいる部屋の御簾を引く。 源氏は裾を長く引いた大君姿。
scene.contenten: Invited to the wisteria banquet at the Minister of the Right's residence, Genji seeks the woman of the banquet night and pulls aside the blinds of the room of the First and Third Princesses; Genji wears a long-trailed court-lady's guise.

scene.content: 女(朧月夜)を捜し当てた源氏、几帳ごしに手を取り歌を交わす。
scene.contenten: Finding the woman (Oborozukiyo), Genji takes her hand through the screen and exchanges poems.

summaryen: Following a court cherry blossom banquet, Genji encounters a charming lady humming a verse under the hazy moon in the palace corridors and shares a brief night with her, exchanging fans as a token. At a subsequent wisteria banquet held by the Minister of the Right, Genji identifies her as Oborozukiyo, the Minister's sixth daughter destined for the Crown Prince, beginning an illicit entanglement.

title: 葵
summary: 桐壺帝が譲位し朱雀帝が即位。賀茂祭の御禊の日、正妻・葵の上と六条御息所の間で牛車の場所を巡る「車争い」が起こり、辱めを受けた御息所は深い恨みを抱く。妊娠した葵の上は御息所の生霊に苦しめられ、男子（夕霧）を出産した直後に急死する。服喪ののち二条院に戻った源氏は、美しく成人した紫の上とついに新枕を交わし名実ともに夫婦となる。
gendaibun: 御世が変わってからというもの、源氏は何事につけても気が重くなられ、身分が高重になるにつれて軽々しいお忍び歩きも慎まれるようになったため、あちこちの女君たちからは頼りなげな恨みを受けられるようになった。
gendaibunen: Ever since the accession of the new reign, Genji had felt disheartened by everything; as his station grew more exalted, he could no longer make casual excursions under cover of darkness, bringing anxious complaints from the ladies whom he now visited less frequently.
kobun: 世の中かはりて後、よろづもの憂く思され、御身のやむごとなさも添ふにや、軽々しき御忍び歩きもつつましうて、ここもかしこも、おぼつかなさの嘆きを重ねたまふ。
kobunen: After the world changed with the new reign, everything felt dreary to him; as his stature grew increasingly exalted, he became wary of careless secret visits, causing anxious laments to multiply among the ladies in various quarters.

scene.content: 斎院の御禊行列見物の葵の上一行、やはり見物にきていた六条御息所の車と遭遇、召使いたち御息所の車を押しのける(車争い)。
scene.contenten: Lady Aoi's procession viewing the Kamo purification meets the carriage of the Lady of Rokujo, also viewing; Aoi's servants push Rokujo's carriage aside (the carriage quarrel).

scene.content: 源氏、賀茂祭見物に紫の君を連れ出そうとし、その髪を自らそぐ。
scene.contenten: Genji tries to take Murasaki to see the Kamo festival and trims her hair himself.

scene.content: 秋の朝、六条御息所から届いた、菊の枝につけられた見舞いの文に返歌をしたためる源氏。
scene.contenten: On an autumn morning Genji writes a reply to Lady Rokujo's get-well letter attached to a chrysanthemum branch.

summaryen: Following the accession of Emperor Suzaku, a carriage dispute erupts during the Kamo Festival between Lady Aoi's attendants and Lady Rokujo, severely humiliating Rokujo. Soon after, the pregnant Aoi is tormented by Rokujo's living spirit, dying suddenly after delivering a son, Yugiri. After a period of mourning, Genji formally unites in marriage with Murasaki no Ue at the Nijo mansion.

title: 賢木
summary: 生霊の恐ろしさに怯える六条御息所は、娘の斎宮下向に伴い伊勢へ下ることを決意し嵯峨野の野宮に籠もる。晩秋、源氏は野宮を訪ね榊を手に別れを惜しむ。その冬に桐壺院が崩御し、後見を失った藤壺は源氏との過ちを悔いて出家。政権を握った右大臣派が台頭する中、源氏は入内していた朧月夜との密会を右大臣に現場で目撃され、絶体絶命の危機に陥る。
gendaibun: 伊勢の斎宮の御下向は九月と決まった。六条の御息所は、以前から世間の評判を苦にしておいでになり、このごろでは体調もすぐれず、物思いに沈んでお暮らしであった。
gendaibunen: The departure of the Ise Priestess was fixed for the Ninth Month. Lady Rokujo had long suffered from worldly gossip; in recent days she had felt unwell and spent her time lost in melancholy reflection.
kobun: 斎宮の御下り、神無月と定まりて、いとど世の聞こえを思し乱るる御息所、日ごろ患ひたまふこともありて、もの心細う思されけるに。
kobunen: The departure of the High Priestess to Ise having been set for the Tenth Month, Lady Rokujo's heart was further unsettled by malicious worldly gossip; and feeling unwell for days, she sank into forlorn melancholy.

scene.content: 晩秋の野宮に六条御息所を訪ねた源氏、榊の枝を御簾の中に差し入れ、歌を交わす。
scene.contenten: Visiting the Lady of Rokujo at the Nonomiya in late autumn, Genji slips a sakaki branch through the blinds and exchanges poems.

scene.content: 桐壺帝崩御後、三条宮に下る藤壺中宮を源氏と螢兵部卿宮が見舞い慰める。庭の池は凍り、五葉松に雪降り積もる。
scene.contenten: After Emperor Kiritsubo's death, Genji and Hotaru Hyobukyo no Miya visit and comfort Fujitsubo, now moving to Sanjo Palace; the garden pond freezes and snow piles on the five-needle pine.

scene.content: 藤壺を慕って忍びいった源氏、屏風の狭間を伝って藤壺の室に入り込もうとする。
scene.contenten: Longing for Fujitsubo, Genji steals in and tries to enter her chamber through a gap in the screens.

scene.content: 雲林院に籠もった源氏より文をつけて届けられた紅葉を藤壺うとましく思い、瓶にいれて廂の柱のもとに遠ざける。
scene.contenten: Fujitsubo finds the autumn leaves sent with a poem by Genji, cloistered at Unrin-in, distasteful, and has them placed in a vase by a gallery pillar.

scene.content: 桐壺院の一周忌の後まもなく藤壺出家。驚いた源氏、命婦を介して悲しみを訴える。雪に月、くまなく照る。
scene.contenten: Soon after the first anniversary of Emperor Kiritsubo, Fujitsubo takes the tonsure; shocked, Genji laments through Myobu; snow and moon shine everywhere.

summaryen: Haunted by her living spirit, Lady Rokujo resolves to accompany her daughter the Priestess to Ise and secludes herself at the Nonomiya, where Genji bids her a poignant farewell with a branch of sacred sakaki. In winter the Kiritsubo Emperor dies, and the unprotected Fujitsubo takes the tonsure to expiate her transgression. Amid the ascendance of the rival Right Minister's faction, Genji is discovered in an illicit tryst with Oborozukiyo, precipitating a grave political crisis.

title: 花散里
summary: 政界での立場が悪化し孤立を深める源氏は、五月雨の晴れ間に故桐壺院の後宮であった麗景殿女御の邸を訪れる。世間から見捨てられた静寂のなかで亡き父帝を追慕し語り合ったのち、女御の妹でかつて契りを交わした花散里の部屋を訪れる。激動の最中、源氏は変わらぬ人柄と優しい風情に深い慰めを見出す。
gendaibun: 政変の嵐が吹きすさび、世間が不安に満ちてくるにつれ、源氏のお心はますます沈みがちになり、宮廷へ参内されることもめったになく、二条院に閉じこもっておいでになった。
gendaibunen: As political storms raged and the court grew turbulent, Genji's heart sank into deep gloom; seldom presenting himself at the imperial palace, he remained cloistered at his Nijo mansion.
kobun: 世の中いと鬱陶しう、乱れがましき心地のみして、公にも出でたまはず、二条院にのみ籠もりおはして、月日を過ぐしたまふ。
kobunen: The court world had become exceedingly oppressive and full of unrest, so that Genji refrained from appearing at court, passing the quiet months and days secluded in his Nijo residence.

scene.content: 源氏、中川辺りで、聞こえた琴の音に興を引かれ惟光を入らす。 門前に桂の木あり、時鳥鳴き過ぎる。
scene.contenten: Near Nakagawa, drawn by a koto, Genji sends Koremitsu in; a katsura tree stands before the gate and a cuckoo calls as it passes.

scene.content: 源氏、麗景殿女御 (花散里の姉)のもとでも時鳥を聞き、昔話をしてから、花散里に逢う。
scene.contenten: At the Reikeiden Consort's (Hanachirusato's elder sister) Genji hears a cuckoo, talks of old times, and then meets Hanachirusato.

summaryen: As political hostility surrounds him, Genji visits the residence of the Reikeiden Consort, a gentle lady from his late father's court, on an evening when summer rains clear. In that quiet household they reminisce nostalgically about the old days, after which Genji passes the night with her younger sister, Hanachirusato, finding warmth and peace in her enduring gentleness.

title: 須磨
summary: 右大臣派の弾劾を察知した源氏は、公式の配流処分を受ける前に自ら須磨への退去を決断する。二条院の紫の上と涙ながらに別れを告げ、父帝の山陵や左大臣邸を密かに訪れて京を発つ。寂寥たる須磨の浦で従者らと侘住まいを送り、頭中将の見舞いを受ける。翌年の上巳の祓の日に激しい嵐と雷雨に見舞われ、須磨の館が被災する中で源氏は神仏に祈りを捧げる。
gendaibun: 源氏の身の上についての世間の噂はますます不穏になり、公の処罰が下るのも間近であると見えたので、都を出て隠退しようというお気持ちになられた。
gendaibunen: Rumors concerning Genji's situation grew ever more menacing, and seeing that imperial disgrace was imminent, he resolved to abandon the capital and withdraw into exile.
kobun: 源氏の上の御身の上のこと、いとどあや難きこと多くなりて、世の咎めも近づきぬべければ、都を出でたまひなむとす。
kobunen: As rumors surrounding Genji's position multiplied and punishment from the court appeared imminent, he resolved to depart from the capital.

scene.content: 源氏、暇乞いのためひそかに左大臣邸を訪れ、夕霧を膝に載せて涙する。左大臣も渡ってくる。
scene.contenten: To take leave, Genji secretly visits the Minister of the Left's residence and weeps with Yugiri on his knee; the Minister also comes over.

scene.content: 左大臣邸の女房、中納言の君のもとで一泊した源氏、帰りぎわに勾欄によって桜を眺める。中納言の君、妻戸を開けて見送る。
scene.contenten: After a night at the Minister's residence with the Chunagon no Kimi, Genji gazes at cherry blossoms from the balustrade on leaving; she opens the door to see him off.

scene.content: 流謫の源氏、須磨の秋の夜に一人琴を弾き謡う。惟光ら、目覚めて都を偲んですすり泣く。
scene.contenten: In exile at Suma, Genji plays the koto and sings alone on an autumn night; Koremitsu and the others wake and weep longing for the capital.

scene.content: 源氏、海の見える廊に出て、 沖行く舟や雁の列を眺める。
scene.contenten: Genji goes out to the corridor overlooking the sea and watches boats and lines of wild geese.

scene.content: 雪の降る日、源氏七弦琴を弾き、良清に歌わせ、 惟光に笛を吹かせて遊ぶ。
scene.contenten: On a snowy day Genji plays the seven-stringed koto, has Yoshikiyo sing, and Koremitsu play the flute.

scene.content: 春となり、都の桜を偲ぶ源氏のもとを頭中将が見舞う。竹を編んだ垣を巡らせた唐風の山荘のようす。
scene.contenten: In spring To no Chujo visits Genji, who longs for the capital's cherries; a Chinese-style villa ringed by a bamboo fence.

scene.content: 頭中将と源氏、ともに山荘の馬が稲を喰うさまを珍しく眺める。
scene.contenten: Genji and To no Chujo watch with amusement a horse eating rice plants at the villa.

scene.content: 三月朔日上巳の日、源氏、浜で御禊、天変突発して暴風雨となる。
scene.contenten: On the third day of the third month Genji performs purification at the beach; a sudden storm breaks.

summaryen: Anticipating official ruin, Genji voluntarily retreats into exile at Suma. He parts sorrowfully from Murasaki no Ue and his son Yugiri before traveling to the deserted coast. Living in rustic loneliness, he finds solace in painting and music, receiving a brief visit from To no Chujo. During a purification ritual on the beach the following spring, a tremendous tempest strikes, driving Genji to deep prayer amid supernatural turmoil.

title: 明石
summary: 嵐の夜に父・桐壺院の夢告を受けた源氏のもとに、明石入道が迎えの舟を寄せる。明石の別邸に移った源氏は厚遇を受け、入道の娘・明石の御方と文を交わすうちに契りを結ぶ。明石の御方はやがて源氏の子を身籠る。一方都では天変地異が相次ぎ、桐壺院の霊に責められた朱雀帝は眼病を患い、源氏の罪を赦免する勅旨を下す。源氏は明石の御方に再会を誓い、名残を惜しみつつ帰京する。
gendaibun: 須磨の浦の風はますます激しく吹き荒れ、雨足もやむ気配がなく、雷鳴がとどろき稲妻がひらめいて、あたりは昼も暗い有様であった。
gendaibunen: At the shore of Suma the wind blew with relentless fury and the rain showed no sign of abating; thunder crashed and lightning flashed so violently that even mid-day was turned to pitch blackness.
kobun: 須磨の浦風、吹き乱れて、雨もやまぬに、雷鳴りひらめきて、昼も闇のやうなる心地するに、源氏の君、いと心細く思さる。
kobunen: At Suma the shore gale blew wild and the rains continued unabated; lightning flamed and thunder rumbled, casting a midday darkness in which Genji felt terribly forlorn.

scene.content: 源氏の夢に桐壺帝の現われた翌朝、夢のお告げどおり、明石の入道よりの迎えの舟がつく。
scene.contenten: The morning after Emperor Kiritsubo appears in Genji's dream, a boat sent by the Akashi recluse arrives, as the dream foretold.

scene.content: 入道邸に移った源氏、初夏の夕月夜に琴を奏で、入道は琵琶を弾く。
scene.contenten: Moved to the recluse's residence, Genji plays the koto on an early-summer moonlit evening; the recluse plays the biwa.

scene.content: 八月十三夜、源氏、馬に乗り、入江沿いに明石の君のもとに向かう。
scene.contenten: On the thirteenth night of the eighth month, Genji rides along the inlet toward Lady Akashi.

scene.content: 明石の君、几帳の傍らで箏を弾きさしているところへ、源氏訪れる。
scene.contenten: Lady Akashi plays the koto at the side of a screen; Genji visits.

scene.content: 明石の浦出立も間もない源氏、明石の君と一夜を過ごし琴を弾く。
scene.contenten: Soon before leaving Akashi Bay, Genji spends a night with Lady Akashi, playing the koto.

scene.content: 琴の音に堪えられず、 入道、箏を娘に促し、御簾の内へと差し入れる。
scene.contenten: Unable to bear the music, the recluse urges his daughter to play and slips a koto inside the blinds.

summaryen: Following a dream in which his late father appears, Genji is rescued by the former Governor of Akashi (the Novice) and sheltered at his seaside mansion. Genji enters into a relationship with the Novice's refined daughter, the Lady of Akashi, who becomes pregnant. Meanwhile in Kyoto, calamities and portents afflict Emperor Suzaku until he issues an imperial pardon. Pledging to send for the expecting lady, Genji tearfully journeys back to the capital.

title: 澪標
summary: 都に戻った源氏は内大臣・太政大臣代行として復権。朱雀帝が譲位し、源氏と藤壺の実子である東宮が冷泉帝として即位する。明石では女児（明石の姫君）が誕生。秋、源氏は須磨明石での加護に報いるため住吉大社へ盛大な御礼参詣を行うが、折悪しく舟で参詣に来ていた明石の御方はその栄華に圧倒され名乗り出ずに立ち去る。帰京した六条御息所が死の床で娘（前斎宮）の後見を源氏に託す。
gendaibun: 源氏の大臣は、都へお帰りになってからというもの、目を見張るほどの権勢をお取り戻しになり、宮廷の政治を一手に引き受けられるようになった。
gendaibunen: Ever since his return to the capital, the Lord Genji had regained astonishing power and authority, personally overseeing all matters of imperial administration.
kobun: 源氏の大臣、京に帰りたまひて後、世の覚えいといたうまさりて、朝政を思すままに執り行ひたまふ。
kobunen: After Lord Genji returned to the capital, his prestige at court mounted immensely, and he directed the affairs of state entirely at his discretion.

scene.content: 明石の君、姫君のために源氏が遣わした乳母とともに源氏よりの文を読み語り合う。
scene.contenten: Lady Akashi reads and discusses with the nurse sent by Genji, for her daughter's sake, the letter from him.

scene.content: 明石の君よりの文を繰り返し読む源氏、恨み顔の紫の上に明石の君の美しい手跡を見せる。
scene.contenten: Rereading Lady Akashi's letter, Genji shows her beautiful handwriting to the pouting Murasaki.

scene.content: 五月の朧月夜、源氏、 花散里を訪れ、荒れた庭を見ながら間近で鳴く水鶏を聞いて歌を交わす。
scene.contenten: On a hazy moonlit night in May, Genji visits Hanachirusato, hearing a water rail cry close by as they view the neglected garden and exchange poems.

scene.content: 秋、源氏供人を整え、住吉詣。 源氏の栄華を目のあたりにした明石の君の住吉詣の舟はそのまま住吉の浜を去る。
scene.contenten: In autumn Genji sets out for Sumiyoshi with attendants; the boat of Lady Akashi, who has seen Genji's glory, leaves Sumiyoshi beach as it is.

scene.content: 源氏一行、難波に行き、明石の君の舟と邂逅。明石の君への歌を口ずさむ源氏に惟光は筆と硯を奉る。
scene.contenten: Genji's party goes to Naniwa and encounters Lady Akashi's boat; as Genji hums a poem to her, Koremitsu offers brush and inkstone.

scene.content: 病のため出家した六条御息所を見舞った源氏、几帳の隙間より斎宮を垣間見る。
scene.contenten: Genji visits the Lady of Rokujo, who has taken the tonsure through illness, and glimpses the Saiin through a gap in the curtain.

summaryen: Reinstated at court, Genji rises to Minister of the Center. Suzaku abdicates, and Reizei—secretly Genji and Fujitsubo's son—ascends the throne. In Akashi, a baby girl is born. When Genji makes a triumphant thanksgiving pilgrimage to Sumiyoshi Shrine, the Lady of Akashi witnesses his grand procession from her modest boat and withdraws in shame without meeting him. Meanwhile, the dying Lady Rokujo entrusts the guardianship of her daughter, the former Priestess, to Genji.

title: 蓬生
summary: 源氏が須磨に隠棲していた間、末摘花は召使いたちが去り荒廃していく常陸宮邸で、叔母からの筑紫下向の誘いを断り頑なに源氏の帰りを待ち続けていた。帰京の翌年春、花散里を訪ねる途中で雑草が生い茂る廃邸に気づいた源氏は、それが末摘花の住まいであることを思い出す。長年の変わらぬ一途な純情に打たれた源氏は手厚い支援を施し、後に二条東院へ引き取る。
gendaibun: 源氏の大臣が須磨においでになったころの、末摘花の姫君の心細い暮らしぶりといったら、世間にも例がないほどであった。
gendaibunen: During the period when Lord Genji was in exile at Suma, Princess Suetsumuhana's forlorn condition was miserable beyond all comparison in this world.
kobun: 源氏の大臣、須磨におはしまししころの常陸の宮の姫君、頼みきこえつる人を遠く隔てて、いとど心細きこと限りなし。
kobunen: While Lord Genji was dwelling at Suma, Princess Suetsumuhana, severed from the one protector she trusted, sank into the utmost desolation.

scene.content: 末摘花邸荒廃する。
scene.contenten: Suetsumuhana's residence falls into ruin.

scene.content: 荒れ果てた邸内で、困窮した暮しを続ける末摘花、かぐや姫物語などを絵に描いたものなど引き出してみて無聊を慰める。
scene.contenten: In the desolate mansion, impoverished Suetsumuhana brings out pictures of the Tale of the Bamboo Cutter and the like to relieve her boredom.

scene.content: 末摘花の伯母、筑紫下向に際して末摘花を伴おうと荒れた邸を訪れ、わずかに格子の開いている南面に無作法に車を寄せる。
scene.contenten: Suetsumuhana's aunt comes to the ruined mansion to take her along on a journey to Tsukushi, rudely drawing her carriage up to the south side where a lattice stands ajar.

scene.content: 源氏、花散里訪問の途上、松に藤のかかる荒廃した末摘花邸に気付き、惟光にようすをうかがわせる。
scene.contenten: On the way to visit Hanachirusato, Genji notices the ruined residence with wisteria over the pines and has Koremitsu inquire.

scene.content: 末摘花邸の蓬の生い茂る庭を、惟光に露を払わせながら源氏進む。
scene.contenten: Genji advances through the mugwort-grown garden of Suetsumuhana's residence as Koremitsu brushes the dew aside.

scene.content: 末摘花と再会した源氏、松(待つ)にことよせて歌を詠み、慰める。
scene.contenten: Reunited with Suetsumuhana, Genji composes a poem on the pine (matsu, to wait) to comfort her.

summaryen: Throughout Genji's absence in Suma, Suetsumuhana faithfully endured poverty in her ruined, weed-choked residence, refusing her vulgar aunt's offers to take her to Kyushu. On his way to visit Hanachirusato the following spring, Genji recognizes the dilapidated gate overrun by wild mugwort. Deeply touched by her unwavering constancy, Genji renovates her estate and later relocates her to his Nijo East Palace.

title: 関屋
summary: 夫・常陸介の任期満了に伴い常陸から帰京する空蝉の一行と、石山寺へ御礼参詣に向かう源氏の盛大な行列が逢坂の関で偶然行き交う。関守の館の木陰に牛車を引き寄せて見送る空蝉に対し、源氏は従者の小君（紀伊守の弟）を介して文と歌を贈り、往年の逢瀬の追憶を交わし合う。
gendaibun: 常陸介は任期が明けて、一家を連れて都へ上ることになった。逢坂の関を越えようとする日、奇しくも源氏の大臣の石山参詣の行列と行き逢うことになった。
gendaibunen: The Deputy Governor of Hitachi had completed his term and was traveling up to the capital with his household. On the very day they crossed the Osaka Barrier, they happened to cross paths with Lord Genji's grand pilgrimage to Ishiyama.
kobun: 常陸介、任果てて上る道に、逢坂の関を越ゆる日、源氏の大臣の石山に詣でたまふに行き逢ひけり。
kobunen: The Deputy Governor of Hitachi, returning on the road after his term had ended, happened to encounter Lord Genji's procession bound for Ishiyama on the day he crossed the Osaka Barrier.

scene.content: 源氏、石山詣の途次、秋の逢坂の関で上京途中の常陸介・空蝉の一行に逢う。空蝉らは源氏の行列に道を譲り、木陰に車を引き入れて、行列を見送る。
scene.contenten: On the way to Ishiyama, Genji meets the party of Hitachi no Suke and Utsusemi traveling to the capital at Osaka Barrier in autumn; they yield the road, draw their carriage into the shade, and watch the procession.

scene.content: 左衛門佐（小君）、源氏の車に近づき、車から差し出された文を受け取る。
scene.contenten: Saemon no Suke (Kogimi) approaches Genji's carriage and receives a letter offered from it.

scene.content: 石山より戻った源氏、左衛門佐に会い、空蝉への文を託す。
scene.contenten: Returning from Ishiyama, Genji meets Saemon no Suke and entrusts him with a letter to Utsusemi.

summaryen: Returning to the capital with her husband after his provincial tenure in Hitachi, Utsusemi unexpectedly encounters Genji's magnificent procession en route to Ishiyama Temple at the Osaka Barrier. Yielding the road and waiting under the trees, Utsusemi receives a poetic letter sent from Genji's carriage through her brother Kogimi, fondly recalling their unforgotten past.

title: 絵合
summary: 冷泉帝の後宮で、源氏が後見する斎宮女御（梅壺女御）と、権中納言（頭中将）の娘・弘徽殿女御が寵を競う。絵画を好む帝の関心を惹こうと宮中で「絵合」が開催される。古今の名画が競われるなか、最後に源氏が須磨・明石で自ら描いた流謫の日記絵巻が出され、藤壺や冷泉帝をはじめ満座を深く感動させて梅壺方の完全勝利となる。
gendaibun: 梅壺の女御が参内なさって後、冷泉帝は絵を好まれる御性質であったので、女御が絵をよくお描きになるのを格別に興深く思され、御愛情もひと通りでなかった。
gendaibunen: After the Umetsubo Consort entered court service, Emperor Reizei, being of an artistic nature, took special delight in her excellent painting and favored her with boundless affection.
kobun: 梅壺の女御、参りたまひてのち、主上、絵を好ませたまへば、女御のよく描かせたまふを、めづらしく思しのたまはせて、御心寄せも浅からず。
kobunen: After the Umetsubo Consort entered court service, the Emperor, who loved paintings, was deeply delighted by her refined brushwork and bestowed extraordinary favor upon her.

scene.content: 冷泉帝は絵を好み、梅壺女御も絵をよくするので、帝は梅壺の局にしばしば通って絵を描かせる。
scene.contenten: Emperor Reizei loves pictures, and Lady Umetsubo paints well, so the Emperor often visits her chamber to have her paint.

scene.content: 源氏、絵合せのための絵を選び、紫の上に須磨の絵日記を見せる。
scene.contenten: Genji selects pictures for a picture contest and shows Murasaki the Suma picture diary.

scene.content: 藤壺、絵合せを催す。女房たち、二手に分かれて、優劣を論じ合う。
scene.contenten: Fujitsubo holds a picture contest; the ladies divide into two sides and debate superiority.

scene.content: 冷泉帝御前での絵合せ。 左右よりの絵を沈や紫檀の箱にいれ、人々居並ぶ。藤壺も臨席。
scene.contenten: The picture contest before Emperor Reizei: pictures from left and right are placed in aloeswood and rosewood boxes as people line up; Fujitsubo also attends.

scene.content: 絵合せ後の竟宴。
scene.contenten: The after-contest feast following the picture contest.

summaryen: At the court of Emperor Reizei, a rivalry unfolds between the Umetsubo Consort, backed by Genji, and the Kokiden Consort, backed by To no Chujo. A magnificent court Picture Contest is arranged before the Emperor and Fujitsubo. After famous ancient and modern scrolls are matched, Genji produces his private illustrated journals from his Suma and Akashi exile, moving the assembly to tears and securing an overwhelming victory for Umetsubo.

title: 松風
summary: 源氏の勧めで明石の御方が娘を連れて上洛し、大堰川の別荘に入る。父・明石入道と別れて都へ上った御方のもとへ、源氏は人目を忍んで通い、成長した我が子と初めて対面する。紫の上は源氏の隠し子に嫉妬を覚えるが、やがて後継ぎのない自らの養女として引き取り養育することを承諾する。
gendaibun: 明石の御方は、源氏の内大臣のお勧めによって上京しようとするにつけても、自分の身分の低さを思っては気後れし、ためらいがちに日を送っていた。
gendaibunen: Though encouraged by Lord Genji to move to the capital, the Lady of Akashi hesitated day after day, intimidated by her own modest lineage.
kobun: 明石の御方、内大臣の御すすめによりて、上らむとするにも、身のほど思ひ知られて、やすからず思ひ惑ふ。
kobunen: Encouraged by the Minister of the Center to come up to the capital, the Lady of Akashi was perplexed and anxious, acutely conscious of her modest birth.

scene.content: 明石の君母子、舟で上洛。入道、舟を見送る。
scene.contenten: Lady Akashi and her child come up to the capital by boat; the recluse sees them off.

scene.content: 上京して大堰の山荘に住む明石の君、源氏の形見の琴を弾く。松風、音を合わせるように鳴る。傍らに明石の尼君。
scene.contenten: Lady Akashi, now at the Oi villa in the capital, plays the koto left as Genji's keepsake; the wind in the pines sounds as if accompanying; the Akashi nun is beside her.

scene.content: 大堰の山荘より帰ろうとする源氏を乳母、姫君を抱いて見送る。 明石の君は几帳の陰に伏す。
scene.contenten: As Genji prepares to leave the Oi villa, the nurse sees him off holding the princess; Lady Akashi lies hidden behind a screen.

scene.content: 源氏、桂殿にて遊宴。 迎えの人々、 荻の枝に小鳥をつけて奉る。
scene.contenten: Genji feasts at the Katsura Palace; his escorts present a small bird tied to a branch of eulalia.

scene.content: 夜更け、紫の上のところにいる源氏のもとへ、明石の君の文が届く。源氏、読んでから紫の上にも見せ、脇息によって明石の君を想う。
scene.contenten: Late at night a letter from Lady Akashi arrives for Genji at Murasaki's; after reading it he shows it to Murasaki and, leaning on an armrest, longs for Lady Akashi.

summaryen: At Genji's urging, the Lady of Akashi travels to the capital with her young daughter, settling at a secluded villa by the Oi River. Genji visits secretly and meets his daughter for the first time. In the capital, Murasaki no Ue grapples with jealousy over Genji's daughter, but eventually consents to adopt and rear the child in her own quarters.

title: 薄雲
summary: 明石の姫君の将来のため、明石の御方は涙をのんで娘を二条院の紫の上の養女として預ける。翌年春、藤壺女院が三十七歳で崩御し、源氏は深い絶望に沈む。夜居の僧都の密告によって冷泉帝は自らが源氏の実子であることを知り、帝位を譲ろうとするが源氏は固辞。冷泉帝は源氏に太政大臣への昇進を打診する。
gendaibun: 大堰の山荘から明石の姫君を二条院へお迎えすることになった。生みの母である明石の御方の悲しみは言うまでもなく、乳母をはじめ付き添う人々もみな涙に暮れた。
gendaibunen: Arrangements were made to receive the young Akashi princess from the Oi villa into the Nijo mansion. The sorrow of her mother, the Lady of Akashi, was beyond words, and all her attendants wept bitterly.
kobun: 大堰の姫君、二条の院に迎へたてまつりたまふ。生ひ出づるほど、いとあはれに思し嘆く母君の御心、言ひ尽くすべくもあらず。
kobunen: The young princess of Oi was received into the Nijo mansion. The mother's grief as she parted from her precious child was sorrowful beyond all expression.

scene.content: 迎えの車を寄せたところに明石の君自ら姫君を抱いて出る。同行する乳母ら、守り刀などを車に入れさせる。
scene.contenten: When the carriage is brought up, Lady Akashi herself comes out bearing the princess; the accompanying nurse has the guardian sword and such placed in the carriage.

scene.content: 大堰への出がけに、紫の上のところに寄った源氏の裾に姫君、無邪気にまつわりつく。
scene.contenten: As he sets out for Oi, Genji stops by Murasaki's, and the princess innocently clings to his robe.

scene.content: 源氏、藤壺女院の死を悲しみ、ひとり念誦堂に籠もって夕陽を眺め、物思いに耽ける。
scene.contenten: Genji grieves Fujitsubo's death, cloisters alone in the invocation hall, watches the setting sun, and broods.

scene.content: 二条院に里帰りした斎宮女御、秋雨の庭を見る。 源氏、柱により几帳を隔てて語り合う。
scene.contenten: The Saiin Princess, returned to Nijo-in, views the autumn-rain garden; Genji talks with her through a curtain by a pillar.

scene.content: 嵯峨の念仏にかこつけて大堰に明石の君を訪れた源氏、篝火の見え隠れする大堰川の風情を眺め、悲しむ明石の君を慰める。
scene.contenten: On the pretext of nembutsu at Saga, Genji visits Lady Akashi at Oi, views the Oi River with bonfires appearing and vanishing, and comforts the grieving lady.

summaryen: For the child's royal future, the Lady of Akashi tearfully relinquishes her daughter into the custody of Murasaki no Ue at Nijo Palace. The following spring, Empress Fujitsubo passes away, leaving Genji in profound despair. Secretly informed by an ascetic monk of his true paternity, Emperor Reizei attempts to yield the throne to Genji, but Genji firmly declines, choosing to protect the dangerous secret.

title: 朝顔
summary: 賀茂斎院を退下した朝顔の姫君（桃園式部卿宮の娘）に対し、源氏は再び熱心に文を送り求婚するが、朝顔は源氏の好色と身の破滅を警戒し頑なに拒み通す。紫の上は源氏の執心に不安を募らせるが、雪の夜、源氏は紫の上と語り合いながら歴代の女君たちへの想いを述べて紫の上への愛を確かめ合う。その夜の夢に藤壺の亡霊が現れ、秘密を漏らしたと源氏を厳しく責め立てる。
gendaibun: 五節の舞姫の催しも終わって、宮廷がようやく静まり返ったころ、斎院を退下された桃園の式部卿宮の姫君のことが世間で評判になっていた。
gendaibunen: After the Gosechi maiden dances concluded and the court grew tranquil once more, the world began to talk widely of the Princess of the Taenoki Shikibukyo Prince, who had stepped down as High Priestess.
kobun: 五節の舞姫の事果てて、宮のうち静まりゆくころ、斎院退下したまひにし桃園の式部卿宮の姫君の御こと、世に言ひ騒ぎきこゆ。
kobunen: When the Gosechi dances had ended and the palace returned to quiet, rumors spread actively in the world concerning the daughter of the Taenoki Shikibukyo Prince, who had retired as the Kamo Priestess.

scene.content: 朝顔邸より帰った源氏、 朝霧の庭を眺め、咲き残る朝顔に歌を添え、姫君に贈る。
scene.contenten: Returning from the Asagao residence, Genji views the misty morning garden, adds a poem to the lingering morning glories, and sends it to the princess.

scene.content: 源氏の文に返事を書くようにと侍女たち、朝顔の姫君に硯を勧める。
scene.contenten: Ladies urge the Princess Asagao to take up the inkstone to answer Genji's letter.

scene.content: 源氏、朝顔邸の門に車を寄せ、門番の老翁、錆びた錠を開け惑う。
scene.contenten: Genji draws his carriage to the gate of the Asagao residence; an old gatekeeper fumbles to open the rusted lock.

scene.content: 源氏、女房らに御簾を巻き上げさせ、雪の降り積もった庭にさす月光を紫の上とともにみる。
scene.contenten: Genji has the ladies raise the blinds, and he and Murasaki view moonlight on the snow-covered garden.

scene.content: 源氏と紫の上、童女たちを庭に下ろし、雪転しに興じるさまを見る。池に鴛鴦が鳴く。
scene.contenten: Genji and Murasaki let the girls down into the garden and watch them enjoy snowballing; mandarin ducks call on the pond.

summaryen: Following Princess Asagao's retirement from the Kamo Shrine, Genji resumes his persistent courtship, but she firmly repels his advances to preserve her peace of mind. Murasaki no Ue suffers deep distress over Genji's pursuit, though on a snowy evening Genji reassures her of his supreme love while appraising the ladies of his past. That night, Fujitsubo's angry spirit appears in his dream, fiercely castigating him for having let their secret be known.

title: 少女
summary: 源氏は息子・夕霧をあえて大学寮に入学させ学問に励ませるが、貴公子である夕霧は学問の重荷と従弟・雲居の雁（頭中将の娘）との仲を引き裂かれた寂しさに苦しむ。やがて夕霧は俊才ぶりを発揮して試験を突破。源氏は四町を占める大豪邸「六条院」を落成させ、春の町に紫の上、夏の町に花散里、秋の町に秋好中宮（旧斎宮女御）、冬の町に明石の御方を迎え入れ、一門の栄華を盤石にする。
gendaibun: 源氏の大臣の御子の夕霧の君は、十二歳になられた年の春に元服を迎えられた。東宮御所において成人の儀式が格別な重儀として執り行われた。
gendaibunen: Lord Genji's son, Yugiri, celebrated his coming-of-age in the spring of his twelfth year. The ceremony was performed at the Crown Prince's palace with extraordinary solemnity.
kobun: 源氏の大臣の御子の童殿上したまふ、十二になりたまふ年の春、元服したまふ。春宮の御殿にて、いとことごとしうのたまはせて仕うまつらせたまふ。
kobunen: The young son of Lord Genji, serving as an imperial page, celebrated his coming-of-age in the spring of his twelfth year. The ceremony was performed with great distinction at the Crown Prince's palace.

scene.content: 夕霧 雲居雁を訪ねるが内大臣の命により襖は閉ざされていて会えない。 襖に寄りかかっていると内にいる雲居雁の独り言が聞こえる。
scene.contenten: Yugiri visits Kumoi no Kari, but by the Naidaijin's order the sliding doors are shut and they cannot meet; leaning on the door he hears Kumoi no Kari talking to herself inside.

scene.content: 五節の舞姫を務める惟光の娘に付き添う童女を選び出すため、源氏はとりどりに美しい女童たちを御前に渡らせてみる。
scene.contenten: To choose the girls to attend Koremitsu's daughter dancing the Gosechi, Genji has girls of various beauty presented before him.

scene.content: 惟光の息子、 夕霧よりの文を舞姫を務めた妹に渡す。 兄妹で文を読むところを惟光に見つかり、兄は逃げ出す。
scene.contenten: Koremitsu's son delivers a letter from Yugiri to his sister who danced; Koremitsu catches the siblings reading it and the brother runs off.

scene.content: 六条院で、秋好中宮、箱の蓋に秋の花・紅葉を載せ、美しい童女に持たせて、紫の上に贈る。
scene.contenten: At Rokujo-in, Empress Akikonomu places autumn flowers and colored leaves on a box lid and sends them with a beautiful girl to Murasaki.

summaryen: Genji enrolls his son Yugiri in the University to master scholarship, while To no Chujo abruptly separates Yugiri from his childhood sweetheart, Kumoi no Kari. Demonstrating brilliant talent, Yugiri passes his rigorous examinations. Two years later, Genji completes his monumental Rokujo-in estate, settling Murasaki no Ue in Spring, Hanachirusato in Summer, Empress Akikonomu in Autumn, and the Lady of Akashi in Winter.

title: 玉鬘
summary: 夕顔の遺児・玉鬘は乳母に伴われて筑紫の大宰府で美しく成長するが、粗野な土豪・大夫の監の求婚から逃れるため命がけで京へ脱出する。実父・内大臣の手がかりを求めて初瀬の長谷寺へ参詣した折、偶然にもかつて母に仕えていた右近と劇的な再会を果たす。事情を知った源氏は実の娘として六条院の夏の町へ引き取り、その美貌に心を奪われつつ後見人となる。
gendaibun: 五条の夕顔の君がはかなく亡くなってから、早くも十余年の年月が流れた。残された幼い姫君は、乳母に抱かれて遠く筑紫の国へと下っていた。
gendaibunen: More than ten years had already elapsed since the frail Lady Yugao had passed away so suddenly. Her orphaned little daughter, held by her nurse, had journeyed far down to the distant province of Tsukushi.
kobun: かの五条のわたりにて、はかなくなりにし夕顔の君の御形見の姫君、かの乳母にいだかれて、遠き筑紫の国に下りたまひにけり。
kobunen: The orphaned daughter of Lady Yugao, who had died so suddenly near Fifth Avenue, had been carried off by her nurse to live in the remote province of Tsukushi.

scene.content: 玉鬘、 求婚者より逃れ、早船に乗って上洛。
scene.contenten: Tamakazura escapes her suitors and travels up to the capital on a fast boat.

scene.content: 秋の初瀬に詣でた右近、同宿の人々の中に顔見知りの女を認め、呼び出して、玉鬘一行と知る。弓を持つ男等同行している。
scene.contenten: Ukon, visiting Hatsuse in autumn, recognizes a familiar woman among her fellow lodgers, calls her out, and learns it is Tamakazura's party; men with bows accompany them.

scene.content: 初瀬参詣の玉鬘、右近に再会し、高台にある宿坊で積もる話をして過ごす。下の御堂に参詣する人、多数。
scene.contenten: Tamakazura, on pilgrimage to Hatsuse, is reunited with Ukon, and they spend the time talking in an elevated lodging; many people visit the lower hall.

scene.content: 六条院の西の対に引き取られた玉鬘のもと、夜になってから訪れる源氏。右近、妻戸を開いて迎え入れる。
scene.contenten: Genji visits Tamakazura, taken in at the west wing of Rokujo-in, after nightfall; Ukon opens the door to welcome him.

scene.content: 源氏、几帳を押しやり初めて玉鬘を見る。 右近、灯火をかきあげて近くに寄せる。
scene.contenten: Genji pushes aside the screen and sees Tamakazura for the first time; Ukon lifts the lamp and brings it near.

scene.content: 歳の暮れ、源氏と紫の上、とりどりの衣裳を婦人たちに配るため、 選び整える。
scene.contenten: At year's end Genji and Murasaki sort and arrange robes to distribute to the ladies.

summaryen: Yugao's orphan, Tamakazura, matures into striking beauty in Kyushu, fleeing to Kyoto to escape an aggressive rural suitor. On a pilgrimage to Hase-dera Temple to find news of her father, To no Chujo, she miraculously encounters her mother's former waiting-maid Ukon. Informed of her survival, Genji welcomes Tamakazura into the Summer quarter of the Rokujo-in as his own acknowledged daughter, while silently captivated by her charm.

title: 初音
summary: 六条院で迎える華やかな新春。源氏は紫の上の春の町から各町を巡り、明石の君、花散里、玉鬘らに新年の挨拶を交わす。明石の御方から養女となった姫君へ届いた初音の和歌に源氏は胸を打たれる。六条院に集う若き貴公子たちは、新たに登場した源氏の令嬢・玉鬘の美貌の噂に心を奪われ、新年の宴の陰で恋心を募らせていく。
gendaibun: 新年の六条院は、春の町の寝殿のしつらえをはじめとして、何事もこの上なく華麗で美しく整えられていた。源氏の大臣は元旦の拝賀を終えて、紫の上のお部屋へ渡って来られた。
gendaibunen: For the New Year at the Rokujo-in, everything—beginning with the decorations of the main hall in the Spring quarter—was arranged with supreme elegance and magnificence. Having finished his New Year ceremonies, Lord Genji crossed over to Murasaki's quarters.
kobun: 六条院の春の御殿ののどかなるけしき、年立ち返る朝より、ことさらに言ひ立てむもさらなりや。大臣、元日の御拝済ませたまひて、紫の上のおはします対に渡りたまへり。
kobunen: The peaceful springtime elegance of the Rokujo-in on New Year's morning was beyond all need of praise. Having concluded his ceremonial homage, the Minister crossed over to the pavilion of Murasaki no Ue.

scene.content: 六条院の正月、源氏、紫の上と鏡餅の祝いをする。
scene.contenten: At the New Year at Rokujo-in, Genji celebrates with Murasaki over mirror mochi.

scene.content: 明石の君より鶯をつけた五葉松を飾った髭籠につけて明石の姫君に贈られた手紙を源氏見る。 子の日なので、女童たち、庭で小松を引く。
scene.contenten: Genji sees the letter sent to the Akashi Princess, attached to a basket decorated with a five-needle pine and a warbler, from Lady Akashi; as it is the day of the rat, the girls pull young pines in the garden.

scene.content: 源氏、明石の君のもとを訪れ、琴などの置かれた室内で手習い反古を見て、自らも筆をとって書いてみるところへ、明石の君いざり出る。
scene.contenten: Genji visits Lady Akashi and, in a room with kotos and such, examines old practice papers and takes up a brush himself, when Lady Akashi comes crawling out.

scene.content: 男踏歌の翌日、源氏、みごとな袋に収めてあった琴を数多く取り出して、調弦し、婦人たちを集めて内々の後宴をしようと考える。
scene.contenten: The day after the men's toka, Genji takes out many fine kotos kept in splendid bags, tunes them, and plans a private after-feast for the ladies.

summaryen: A resplendent New Year unfolds throughout the Rokujo-in as Genji makes ceremonial rounds through each quarter, exchanging poetic greetings with Murasaki no Ue, the Lady of Akashi, Hanachirusato, and Tamakazura. Genji is deeply touched by an affectionate 'first song' poem sent by the Lady of Akashi to her daughter. Meanwhile, young nobles visiting to pay respects find their minds set ablaze by rumors of Tamakazura's maidenly charm.

title: 胡蝶
summary: 春三月、秋好中宮の里下がりを迎えた六条院で豪勢な池の舟遊びが催され、鳥や蝶に扮した童女たちが雅楽を奏でる。美しく成長した玉鬘には蛍兵部卿宮や柏木ら多くの貴公子から求婚の文が届くが、養父である源氏自身も玉鬘への恋情を抑えられなくなり、橘の実を手に戯れかけて言い寄り、玉鬘を当惑させる。
gendaibun: 三月になって、春の町の庭は木々の梢も花盛りになり、池の汀の草の青みも風情を添えて、世にまたとない春景色となった。
gendaibunen: With the Third Month, the garden of the Spring quarter was laden with blossoming boughs, and the lush greenery along the water's edge added peerless enchantment to this unmatched springtime landscape.
kobun: 弥生になりて、春の町の御前、木々の梢も咲き満ち、池の汀の草の色も、ことに心とどまるばかり見所多かり。
kobunen: When the Third Month arrived, the garden blossoms in the Spring quarter reached full magnificence, and the verdant greens fringing the pond presented a scenery of rare delight.

scene.content: 六条院で春の船楽。 花咲き誇る庭の他に龍頭鷁首の船。
scene.contenten: Spring boat music at Rokujo-in; besides the garden in full bloom, boats with dragon and bird-head prows.

scene.content: 秋好中宮の仏事に紫の上より鳥と蝶の装束をした童女を使者として、金銀の瓶に挿した桜と山吹が贈られる。
scene.contenten: For Empress Akikonomu's Buddhist service, Murasaki sends girls dressed as birds and butterflies as messengers, with cherries and kerria in gold and silver vases.

scene.content: 源氏、玉鬘のもとに届けられた文が結ばれたままなのを開いて読み、誰からのものか、右近に問う。
scene.contenten: Genji opens and reads the still-tied letter delivered to Tamakazura and asks Ukon who sent it.

scene.content: 玉鬘のもとを訪ね、言い寄った源氏、帰りぎわに御簾を引き上げ、庭の呉竹に寄せた歌を詠みかける。
scene.contenten: Visiting Tamakazura and pressing his suit, Genji on leaving lifts the blinds and recites a poem likening her to the bamboo in the garden.

scene.content: 夕暮れ、源氏、玉鬘のもとで、箱の蓋に菓子とともに盛られた橘の実をもてあそびながら、愛を打ち明けた歌を詠む。
scene.contenten: At dusk at Tamakazura's, Genji toys with tangerines piled with sweets on a box lid and recites a poem revealing his love.

summaryen: In late spring, Empress Akikonomu's visit to the Rokujo-in is celebrated with lavish dragon-prowed boat excursions where maidens costume themselves as birds and butterflies. Suitors like Prince Hotaru and Kashiwagi bombard Tamakazura with passionate letters, but Genji himself finds his passion aroused, half-jestingly declaring his inappropriate affection to a thoroughly flustered Tamakazura.

title: 蛍
summary: 玉鬘に執心する異母弟・蛍兵部卿宮を六条院に招いた源氏は、あらかじめ御簾の中に集めておいた大蛍を放ち、その淡い光の中に浮かび上がった玉鬘の艶美な横顔を宮に見せつけて煽り立てる。五月雨のつれづれに六条院では物語の流行が起こり、絵物語に夢中になる玉鬘に対して源氏は「物語の虚構と真実」を論じる有名な物語論を展開する。
gendaibun: 五月雨のころ、空が晴れる間もなく降りつづいて、宮廷の人々もつれづれをもて余すころ、源氏の大臣は玉鬘の姫君の御殿へ渡って来られた。
gendaibunen: During the long summer rains, when the sky remained unbroken in cloud and courtiers were lost in dreary idleness, Lord Genji crossed over to Princess Tamakazura's quarters.
kobun: 五月雨のころ、つれづれなる空のけしきに、宮のうちも人々もの憂げなるを、大臣、西の対に渡りたまひて、物語の絵など見せたまふ。
kobunen: During the early summer rains, when overcast skies induced listlessness throughout the palace, the Minister crossed to the West wing and displayed picture scrolls to the lady.

scene.content: 螢兵部卿宮、玉鬘を訪ね、 源氏が几帳の帷子を上げて放った螢の光に玉鬘の美しい姿を見る。
scene.contenten: Hotaru Hyobukyo no Miya visits Tamakazura, and by the light of fireflies Genji releases after raising the curtain, sees her beautiful figure.

scene.content: 玉鬘のもとに螢兵部卿宮より菖蒲の根に結び付けて文が届く。 これを見た源氏は返事を書くように勧める。
scene.contenten: From Hotaru Hyobukyo no Miya a letter tied to an iris root arrives for Tamakazura; Genji, seeing it, urges her to write a reply.

scene.content: 六条院馬場大殿で競射。 廊の戸口に御簾を掛け人々見物。
scene.contenten: An archery contest at the Rokujo-in riding ground; blinds hung at the corridor doorway as people watch.

scene.content: 源氏、紫の上がくまの、物語の絵など見ているところに来合わせ、明石の姫君が読む物語について配慮するように注意する。
scene.contenten: Genji comes upon Murasaki looking at pictures such as The Bear of Kumano, and warns her to be mindful of the tales the Akashi Princess reads.

summaryen: When Prince Hotaru visits the Rokujo-in to court Tamakazura, Genji theatrically releases a swarm of fireflies inside her chamber screen, illuminating her dazzling beauty to agitate his brother's passion. Later, during the boredom of the summer rains, Genji discovers Tamakazura engrossed in romances and shares his celebrated aesthetic discourse on the power of fiction and historical truth.

title: 常夏
summary: 猛暑の夏の日、源氏は夕霧や公達を六条院の釣殿に招き、水で冷やした瓜や鮎を食しながら歓談する。内大臣が玉鬘への対抗心から引き取ったもう一人の実娘・近江の君の無作法で奇矯な言動が話題となり、一同の失笑を買う。夕暮れ、撫子（常夏）の花が咲き乱れる庭を眺めながら、源氏は玉鬘を訪れて和琴の手ほどきをし、求愛の情を重ねる。
gendaibun: 夏の日盛りのころ、たいそう蒸し暑い風が吹き通う夕暮れに、源氏の大臣は東の釣殿にお出ましになって涼んでおられた。
gendaibunen: In the height of summer, on a sweltering evening stirred only by warm breezes, Lord Genji went out to the East fishing pavilion to enjoy the cool air.
kobun: いと暑きころ、風だに通はぬ夕暮れに、大臣、東の釣殿に出でたまひて、すずみたまふ。頭中将などの若き人々、さぶらひて、氷水召してまゐりなどす。
kobunen: In the intense summer heat, on a windless evening, the Minister stepped out to the eastern fishing pavilion to catch the breeze, attended by young nobles who served iced water and refreshments.

scene.content: 夏の暑い日、源氏、釣殿で涼をとり、川魚など料理させて、内大臣の子息たちと歓談する。
scene.contenten: On a hot summer day Genji cools off at the fishing pavilion, has river fish prepared, and chats with the Naidaijin's sons.

scene.content: 夕方、源氏、玉鬘を訪ね、貴公子たちも同行。前栽に撫子咲き乱れる。
scene.contenten: In the evening Genji visits Tamakazura, accompanied by young noblemen; pink flowers bloom profusely in the garden.

scene.content: 月のない夜、篝火をたかせ、源氏は玉鬘に琴を教える。玉鬘への恋慕つのる。
scene.contenten: On a moonless night, with bonfires lit, Genji teaches Tamakazura the koto; his longing for her grows.

scene.content: 暑い日、雲居雁が手枕をしてうたた寝する姿を見た内大臣、起こして諫める。
scene.contenten: On a hot day the Naidaijin sees Kumoi no Kari napping on her arm and wakes her to admonish her.

scene.content: 近江の君が五節の君と双六をするところを内大臣覗く。
scene.contenten: The Naidaijin peeks at Lady Omi playing sugoroku with Gosechi no Kimi.

summaryen: On a sultry summer afternoon, Genji hosts Yugiri and courtiers at the cooling fishing pavilion, laughing over tales of the vulgar and rambunctious Lady of Omi, whom To no Chujo recently adopted. Later, amid wild pinks (tokonatsu) flourishing in the garden, Genji visits Tamakazura to instruct her on the Japanese zither, intensifying his covert courtship.

title: 篝火
summary: 初秋の冷気を感じる夜、源氏は玉鬘のもとを訪れ、庭に篝火を焚かせてその幽玄な風情に浸る。琴を枕にして玉鬘と添い臥し、肌を寄せて愛を訴えるが、玉鬘の頑なな恥じらいと困惑を見て一線を越えることは思いとどまる。折から夕霧や柏木らが奏でる笛の音が聞こえ、源氏は彼らを招き入れて合奏の宴を催す。
gendaibun: 秋の気配がようやく身にしむころとなって、風の音ももの寂しく、夕暮れの空が澄み渡るころ、源氏の大臣は西の対へ渡って来られた。
gendaibunen: When autumn chills began to touch the air and the rustle of the wind sounded lonely against the clear dusk, Lord Genji crossed over to the West wing.
kobun: 秋の初風吹き出づるころほひ、空のけしきもあはれなる夕暮れに、大臣、西の対に渡りたまひて、篝火を灯させたまふ。
kobunen: Around the time when the first autumn winds began to blow and dusk evoked tender sorrow, the Minister crossed to the West wing and had bonfires lit in the garden.

scene.content: 夏の夕、源氏、琴を枕に玉鬘に添い乱し、池畔の燃え立つ篝火を見て歌を交わす。
scene.contenten: On a summer evening Genji lies beside Tamakazura using a koto as a pillow, and they exchange poems while watching bonfires blaze by the pond.

scene.content: その折、花散里の東の対から夕霧や柏木らの合奏が聞こえてくる。
scene.contenten: At that time, from Hanachirusato's east wing comes the ensemble of Yugiri, Kashiwagi, and others.

scene.content: 源氏、夕霧・柏木らを玉鬘の方に招き、合奏。源氏は琴を弾く。 御簾の奥に玉鬘。
scene.contenten: Genji invites Yugiri, Kashiwagi, and others to Tamakazura's side for an ensemble; Genji plays the koto, with Tamakazura behind the blinds.

summaryen: On an early autumn evening, Genji orders flares of bonfires lit by the pond, lying beside Tamakazura with a zither for a pillow. Though yearning for intimacy, he refrains from violating her modesty. Hearing Yugiri and Kashiwagi making music nearby, Genji invites them over for an elegant impromptu concert under the flare of the torches.

title: 野分
summary: 激しい野分（台風）が都と六条院を襲う。翌朝、各殿舎を見舞いに回った夕霧は、風に吹き上げられた御簾の隙間から義母・紫の上の神々しい美貌を偶然垣間見て衝撃を受ける。さらに玉鬘の部屋で父・源氏が親密にじゃれ合っている姿を目撃し、父子の不審な関係に疑念を深める。夕霧の心は紫の上の面影と雲居の雁への恋慕の間で激しく揺れ動く。
gendaibun: 八月半ばを過ぎて、激しい野分が吹き荒れ、都の木々の葉も吹き散らされて、庭の植え込みもみな倒れてしまうほどの嵐となった。
gendaibunen: Past the middle of the Eighth Month, a ferocious autumn typhoon raged, stripping trees throughout the capital and ravaging the gardens with tempestuous fury.
kobun: 八月二十日あまりのころ、野分いと吹き荒れて、都の木々も枝折れ、庭の草木も吹き乱れたるさま、言ひ知らずもの憂げなり。
kobunen: Around the twentieth of the Eighth Month, a fierce gale blew violently, snapping boughs throughout the capital and trampling the garden flora into indescribable disorder.

scene.content: 夕霧、野分の風に吹き上げられた御簾を押さえる女房たちを見て微笑む紫の上を垣間見る。
scene.contenten: Yugiri glimpses Murasaki smiling as she watches the ladies hold down blinds blown up by the autumn gale.

scene.content: 野分の翌朝、夕霧は父の使いで秋好中宮を訪問。女童たちが朝霧の庭に下りて虫籠に露を含ませるところを覗き見る。
scene.contenten: The morning after the gale, Yugiri visits Empress Akikonomu on his father's errand; he peeks as girls go into the misty garden and wet the insect cages with dew.

scene.content: 源氏、明るい朝の光の中で玉鬘を引き寄せ戯れる。夕霧はこれを見て驚く。
scene.contenten: Genji draws Tamakazura to him and dallies in the bright morning light; Yugiri is startled to see this.

scene.content: 夕霧、明石の姫君のもとで、女房に料紙をもらい雲居雁へ手紙を書く。
scene.contenten: At the Akashi Princess's, Yugiri gets paper from a lady and writes a letter to Kumoi no Kari.

summaryen: A violent autumn typhoon sweeps through the capital. The following morning, checking on the pavilions, Yugiri catches an accidental glimpse through wind-blown blinds of Murasaki no Ue's peerless countenance, left utterly entranced. Soon after, he witnesses Genji intimately toying with Tamakazura, planting profound doubts about his father's true relationship with his ostensible daughter.

title: 行幸
summary: 冬、冷泉帝の大原野行幸が行われ、行列を見物した玉鬘は冷泉帝の神々しい美しさに魅了される。源氏は玉鬘を宮中へ尚侍として出仕させる計画を進め、実父・内大臣に玉鬘が夕顔の遺児であることをついに明かす。年が明けて二月、六条院で盛大な裳着の儀式が執り行われ、内大臣が腰結の役を務めて涙の親子再会を果たす。
gendaibun: その年の冬、冷泉帝の大原野への行幸が行われた。雪がうっすらと降り積もった朝、御輿の行列が美しく進むさまを人々は競って見物した。
gendaibunen: In the winter of that year, an imperial progress by Emperor Reizei to Oharano took place. On a morning lightly blanketed in snow, people gathered eagerly to behold the imperial procession.
kobun: その年の冬、大原野の行幸あり。雪うち散る朝の御輿のよそほひ、世の常ならずめでたきを、人々見物す。
kobunen: In the winter of that year, the Emperor made an imperial progress to Oharano; on a morning of light snow, crowds gathered to view the peerless splendor of the imperial cortege.

scene.content: 冬の大原野へ行幸。 主上の鳳輦に、親王・上達部ら多数が鷹狩姿で供奉。鷹匠も従う。
scene.contenten: A winter imperial visit to Oharano; many princes and high nobles in hawking dress attend the Emperor's palanquin, along with falconers.

scene.content: 鷹狩り不参の源氏に、帝より枝につけた唯一対が贈られる。
scene.contenten: To Genji, who did not join the hawking, the Emperor sends a pair of fish attached to a branch.

scene.content: 玉鬘の裳着にあたって諸方より祝い物届く。末摘花よりの古風な祝いに添えられた歌を見て源氏赤面する。
scene.contenten: Gifts of congratulation arrive from many quarters for Tamakazura's initiation; seeing the poem attached to Suetsumuhana's old-fashioned gift, Genji blushes.

summaryen: Emperor Reizei journeys on an imperial progress to Oharano, leaving Tamakazura awestruck by his radiant elegance. Genji arranges for Tamakazura to enter court as Palace Attendant and finally reveals the truth to To no Chujo. In the new year, Tamakazura celebrates her coming-of-age ceremony at Rokujo-in, with To no Chujo tying the ceremonial apron cords in a joyful paternal reunion.

title: 藤袴
summary: 秋、夕霧と玉鬘の祖母にあたる大宮が死去し、服喪のため玉鬘の出仕は延期となる。玉鬘が従姉妹であることを知った夕霧は、弔問に訪れた折に藤袴の一枝を御簾に差し入れて好意を告白するが、玉鬘にいなされる。蛍兵部卿宮や髭黒大将らからの求婚の文が殺到する中、玉鬘は行く末に不安を抱きながら喪に服す。
gendaibun: 秋になって、大宮がお亡くなりになった。源氏の大臣をはじめ、内大臣家の人々もみな深い嘆きに沈み、服喪の月日を過ごされた。
gendaibunen: When autumn came, the Omiya passed away. Lord Genji as well as the entire household of the Palace Minister sank into deep mourning, observing the rites with sorrow.
kobun: 秋になりて、大宮かくれさせたまひぬ。大臣をはじめきこえて、内大臣殿の人々も、みな黒木に沈みたまへり。
kobunen: In autumn, the revered Omiya passed away; from the Lord Genji down to the Minister of the Palace's household, all retired in deep mourning robes.

scene.content: 夕霧、源氏の使いで玉鬘を訪ね、藤袴の花を御簾より差し入れて、求愛する。二人ともに喪服姿。
scene.contenten: Yugiri visits Tamakazura on Genji's errand, offers her a purple winter cherry from behind the blinds, and courts her; both are in mourning.

scene.content: 出仕まぢかの玉鬘のもとに諸方より懸想の文が届くが、玉鬘は見ようともしない。螢兵部卿宮よりも霜を置いた笹の枝につけた文が届く。
scene.contenten: Suitors' letters arrive for Tamakazura, soon to enter court service, but she will not look at them; from Hotaru Hyobukyo no Miya comes a letter on a frost-covered bamboo branch.

summaryen: In autumn, grandmother Omiya passes away, deferring Tamakazura's imperial entry due to mourning. Aware that Tamakazura is his cousin, Yugiri visits her quarters and slips a spray of fujibakama into her blinds to express his affection, but is gracefully turned away. Suitors like Prince Hotaru and Lord Higekuro press their suits as Tamakazura waits out the mourning period.

title: 真木柱
summary: 髭黒大将が女房の手引きで玉鬘の部屋へ押し入り強引に契りを結ぶ。冷泉帝への入内を目前に控えていた源氏と内大臣は深く落胆する。玉鬘に執心する髭黒に対し、彼の狂気の正妻（式部卿宮の娘）が灰皿の灰を浴びせかける事件が発生。正妻の父は孫娘（真木柱）を連れて娘を引き取る。真木柱は邸の柱の割れ目に惜別の和歌を残す。翌秋、玉鬘は髭黒の男子を出産する。
gendaibun: 髭黒の大将は、かねてからの思いを遂げて玉鬘の姫君の婿となったものの、世間の評判はいかにも不釣り合いであると取り沙汰されていた。
gendaibunen: Lord Higekuro, having achieved his long-standing desire, became Princess Tamakazura's husband, though society widely whispered that the match was ill-suited.
kobun: 髭黒の大将、思ふことを遂げて、西の対の姫君に住みつきたまへるを、世の人、あやしう見立てまつりて、口惜しがりきこゆ。
kobunen: General Higekuro, having realized his wish and established himself as the Princess's husband at the West wing, was judged by the world to be a lamentably unsuitable match.

scene.content: 心ならずも鬚黒右大将の妻となってしまい、不機嫌な日々を送る玉鬘のもとを、源氏、大将の留守中に訪れる。 玉鬘、几帳に身を隠し、源氏は脇息によって覗く。
scene.contenten: Genji visits Tamakazura, unhappy at having unwillingly become General Higekuro's wife, while the General is away; she hides behind a screen and Genji peers over an armrest.

scene.content: 雪の夜、玉鬘のもとに通う鬚黒大将を身づくろいさせた北の方、突然、大将に火取りを投げかける。
scene.contenten: On a snowy night the principal wife, having dressed Higekuro for his visit to Tamakazura, suddenly throws a fire pan at him.

scene.content: 冬の夕、母とともに家を去ろうとする鬚黒の姫君(真木柱)、歌を書いた紙を柱の割れ目に差し入れ残しおく。
scene.contenten: On a winter evening Higekuro's daughter (Makibashira), about to leave home with her mother, slips a poem written on paper into a crack in a pillar.

scene.content: 玉鬘の去ったあと、主なき西の対に立ち寄った源氏、山吹の咲く春の庭を見て、玉鬘を想う。
scene.contenten: After Tamakazura leaves, Genji stops at the masterless west wing and, seeing the spring garden with blooming kerria, longs for her.

summaryen: Higekuro forces his way into Tamakazura's chamber through a maid's connivance, shattering Genji's plans for her imperial presentation. Higekuro's deranged principal wife pours an incense brazier over his head in jealous fury, causing her father to remove her and their children. The young daughter, Makibashira, wedges a farewell verse into a cypress pillar before departing. The next year, Tamakazura gives birth to Higekuro's son.

title: 梅枝
summary: 明石の姫君の東宮入内を前に、源氏は六条院の女君たち（紫の上・花散里・明石の御方）や朝顔の元斎院に薫物の調合を競わせる「薫物合」を催す。判定役の蛍兵部卿宮を迎えた優雅な春の夜、調香された名香の優劣が競われる。あわせて源氏は入内調度として古今名筆の手習い草子を用意させ、晩春に姫君の盛大な裳着を執り行う。
gendaibun: 春の初めから、明石の姫君の御裳着の支度と入内の御準備とで、六条院の御殿の中は華やかな賑わいに包まれていた。
gendaibunen: From the start of spring, the halls of the Rokujo-in were filled with brilliant bustle as preparations were made for the Akashi Princess's coming-of-age and presentation at court.
kobun: 春のはじめより、明石の姫君の御裳着のこと、入内などの急ぎに、六条院の内、ののしりののしりて過ぐしたまふ。
kobunen: From early spring, the Rokujo-in was filled with bustling excitement as preparations proceeded for the young Akashi Princess's coming-of-age and palace presentation.

scene.content: 朝顔の斎院より源氏のもとに、紺と白の瑠璃の壺にいれた薫物が松と梅の枝をつけて贈られる。螢兵部卿宮、艶なさまに感嘆。
scene.contenten: From the Asagao Saiin, incense in dark blue and white lapis vases, with pine and plum branches, is sent to Genji; Hotaru Hyobukyo no Miya admires the elegance.

scene.content: 源氏、朝顔の斎院への返事の文を紅梅の紙に書き、庭前の梅の枝につけて贈る。
scene.contenten: Genji writes a reply to the Asagao Saiin on crimson plum paper and sends it on a garden plum branch.

scene.content: 明石の姫君の裳着の前夜、源氏と螢兵部卿宮ら、六条院の夫人たちの調合した薫物を合わせる。
scene.contenten: On the eve of the Akashi Princess's initiation, Genji, Hotaru Hyobukyo no Miya, and others blend the incenses prepared by the ladies of Rokujo-in.

scene.content: その明け方、帰ろうとする螢兵部卿宮に源氏、直衣と薫物を贈る。
scene.contenten: At dawn, as Hotaru Hyobukyo no Miya prepares to leave, Genji gives him a noshi robe and incense.

scene.content: 姫君入内のため、源氏、寝殿で女房たちに墨をすらせて草子を書く。
scene.contenten: For the princess's entry to court, Genji has the ladies in the main hall grind ink and write booklets.

summaryen: Anticipating the Akashi Princess's entry into the Crown Prince's palace, Genji arranges a grand incense contest among his ladies, with Prince Hotaru acting as judge on an enchanting spring night. Masterpiece calligraphy scrolls and albums are bound for her dowry, and late in spring the princess's coming-of-age ceremony is celebrated with exquisite splendor.

title: 藤裏葉
summary: 内大臣は夕霧の成長と出世を認め、春の藤波の宴で藤の枝を添えて長年の頑なな態度を改め、娘・雲居の雁との結婚をついに許す。明石の姫君は東宮に入内。さらに冷泉帝は源氏が四十歳を迎えるにあたり、准太上天皇の待遇を贈る勅許を下す。冬、冷泉帝と朱雀院が揃って六条院へ行幸し、かつて高麗の人相見が予言した通り、臣下でありながら天子と同格の栄華を極めるに至る。
gendaibun: 内大臣は、長年反対し続けてきた夕霧と雲居の雁との結婚を、今となってはこれ以上引き止めるべきではないとお思い直しになった。
gendaibunen: The Palace Minister reconsidered the marriage of Yugiri and Kumoi no Kari, deciding it was no longer right to obstruct their union.
kobun: 内大臣、夕霧の君の御事を、いといたう思しめぐらして、雲居の雁の御仲を、今はいかでか塞ぎたまはむと思し定む。
kobunen: The Palace Minister, having reflected carefully on Lord Yugiri's rising position, resolved that he could no longer keep him apart from Kumoi no Kari.

scene.content: 内大臣、 藤花の宴に夕霧を招き、杯に藤の花房を添えて、雲居雁を許す歌を詠む。柏木ら同席する。
scene.contenten: The Naidaijin invites Yugiri to a wisteria banquet, adds a wisteria spray to a cup, and recites a poem granting him Kumoi no Kari; Kashiwagi and others attend.

scene.content: 夕霧より雲居雁のもとに届いた後朝の文を内大臣読む。
scene.contenten: The Naidaijin reads the letter to Kumoi no Kari that Yugiri had delivered.

scene.content: 三条殿に移った新婚の夕霧・雲居雁が、 大宮を偲んでいるところへ庭の紅葉の美しさに引かれて、父太政大臣が訪れる。
scene.contenten: To the newlywed Yugiri and Kumoi no Kari, moved to Sanjo Palace, the father Daijo Daijin visits, drawn by the beauty of the garden's colored leaves as they long for the Omiya.

scene.content: 紅葉の六条院に行幸。反橋・渡殿に錦を敷き、東の池では鵜飼。
scene.contenten: An imperial visit to the autumn-leaves Rokujo-in; brocade is spread on the arched bridge and gallery, and cormorant fishing is shown on the east pond.

summaryen: At a wisteria banquet, To no Chujo finally relents and sanctions the union of Yugiri and Kumoi no Kari. The Akashi Princess safely enters the Crown Prince's court. In celebration of Genji's upcoming fortieth year, Emperor Reizei elevates him to the status of Honorary Retired Emperor. In winter, an imperial progress to Rokujo-in fulfills the ancient prophecy that Genji would reach sovereign glory without sitting on the throne.

title: 若菜上
summary: 朱雀院は出家に際し、最愛の末娘・女三の宮の行く末を案じて源氏への降嫁を懇請する。紫の上の胸中を慮り苦悩しながらも源氏は正妻格として迎え入れる。四十の賀を祝う宴が華やかに続く中、六条院の蹴鞠の日に唐猫が引き開けた御簾の隙間から、柏木が女三の宮の姿を垣間見てしまい、激しい恋情に取り憑かれる。
gendaibun: 朱雀院は御出家の意志をいよいよ固められるにつれて、後に残される女三の宮の御身の上が何としても心残りでならず、どなたを後見にお定め申すべきかと深く思い悩んでおられた。
gendaibunen: As Retired Emperor Suzaku grew ever more resolved to take Buddhist vows, he felt an agonizing concern for the future of his youngest daughter, the Third Princess, brooding deeply over who might serve as her reliable guardian.
kobun: 朱雀院、御出家いよいよ近うなりぬるに、女三の宮の御ことを、いと心苦しう思し嘆きて、いづれの人にか預けきこえむと思しめぐらす。
kobunen: As Retired Emperor Suzaku's departure into religious life drew near, he grieved with intense anxiety over the Third Princess, turning over in his mind to whose care he might entrust her.

scene.content: 源氏の四十の賀を玉、心を尽くして用意し祝う。 若菜を奉る席に玉髪の若君も同伴、歌を交わす。
scene.contenten: For Genji's fortieth-year celebration, the Waka Lady prepares and celebrates with all her heart; the young lord Wakagami accompanies the offering of young herbs, and poems are exchanged.

scene.content: 女三の宮降嫁後、紫の上楽しまず。 硯を引き寄せて歌を詠む。 源氏当惑してより臥す。
scene.contenten: After the Third Princess's marriage, Murasaki is joyless; drawing the inkstone near, she composes a poem; Genji, perplexed, lies down.

scene.content: 雪の早朝、女三の宮のもとより紫の上のもとに帰った源氏、閉められた格子を叩くが、女房たちは気付いてもしばらく開けない。
scene.contenten: On a snowy early morning Genji, returning to Murasaki from the Third Princess's, knocks at the shut lattice, but the ladies, though aware, do not open for a while.

scene.content: 雪の朝、源氏、梅の枝に文をつけて女三の宮のもとに贈る。端近で雪を見る源氏、梅には鶯、奥に紫の上。
scene.contenten: On a snowy morning Genji sends a letter attached to a plum branch to the Third Princess; Genji watches the snow near the edge, a warbler on the plum, Murasaki within.

scene.content: 源氏、朧月夜の邸を早朝に立ち出る。 藤の花が盛りの庭に網代車を寄せる。
scene.contenten: Genji leaves Oborozukiyo's residence at dawn; he draws his carriage up to the garden where wisteria is in full bloom.

scene.content: 十月、源氏の四十の賀に、紫の上は嵯峨御堂で薬師仏を供養、ついで二条院で盛大な賀宴を催す。その夜、楽人たちが褒美の白い衣を肩に掛けて、池畔を帰っていく。
scene.contenten: In the tenth month, for Genji's fortieth celebration, Murasaki offers to the Yakushi Buddha at the Saga chapel, then holds a grand feast at Nijo-in; that night the musicians go home along the pond with white reward robes on their shoulders.

scene.content: 桜の下で蹴鞠に興じる貴公子たちを見ていた女三の宮、猫が偶然に引き開けた御簾の隙間より柏木にその姿を見られる。
scene.contenten: The Third Princess, watching noble youths play kemari under the cherry blossoms, is seen by Kashiwagi through a gap in the blinds a cat happened to pull open.

summaryen: Before retiring from the world, Suzaku Emperor presses Genji to take his cherished youngest daughter, Onna San no Miya, in marriage. Despite worrying deeply about Murasaki's distress, Genji accepts her. Amid celebrations of Genji's fortieth year, a runaway Chinese cat pulls back a window blind during a kemari game, allowing Kashiwagi an unintended glimpse of the young princess that sparks a fatal obsession.

title: 若菜下
summary: 朱雀院の五十の賀を控え六条院で女楽が催されるが、直後に紫の上が重病に倒れ、六条御息所の死霊が現れる。源氏が二条院で紫の上の看病に没頭する隙に、柏木は乳姉妹・小侍従の手引きで女三の宮の寝所に忍び込み懐妊させてしまう。女三の宮宛ての柏木の恋文を発見した源氏は、かつて自らが犯した父帝への裏切りが今巡ってきた因果に戦慄し、祝宴の席で柏木を厳しく諷刺して追いつめる。
gendaibun: 朱雀院の五十の御賀の準備が近づくにつれて、内裏をはじめとして公卿たちの間でも、その催しの晴れやかさが噂され、六条院でも女楽の試楽の支度に追われていた。
gendaibunen: As preparations for Retired Emperor Suzaku's fiftieth anniversary celebration approached, courtiers eagerly discussed the grandeur of the event, and the Rokujo-in was occupied with rehearsals for the women's concert.
kobun: 朱雀院の五十の御賀近うなりて、世の中ののしるころ、六条院の女楽の御試楽のこと、いといたう催し行はる。
kobunen: With the fiftieth celebration of Retired Emperor Suzaku drawing near and the whole court in high excitement, the rehearsal for the women's concert at the Rokujo-in was prepared with utmost elegance.

scene.content: 柏木、女三の宮より春宮に献ぜられた唐猫を手に入れ、愛玩。
scene.contenten: Kashiwagi obtains the Chinese cat given to the Crown Prince by the Third Princess and keeps it as a pet.

scene.content: 源氏、紫の上、明石の中宮、明石の君らを伴って、秋の住吉社に参詣。従者たち、みごとな膳部を次々と源氏らの車に運ぶ。
scene.contenten: Genji visits the autumn Sumiyoshi Shrine with Murasaki, the Akashi Empress, Lady Akashi, and others; attendants carry splendid trays of food to their carriages.

scene.content: 六条院の女楽。明石の君は琵琶、紫の上和琴、明石の中宮箏、女三の宮は琴。源氏・夕霧も加わる。
scene.contenten: Women's music at Rokujo-in: Lady Akashi on the biwa, Murasaki on the wagon, the Akashi Empress on the koto, the Third Princess on the koto; Genji and Yugiri join.

scene.content: 源氏、病後の紫の上とともに盛りの蓮の花を見、歌を詠み交わす。
scene.contenten: Genji views the blooming lotuses with Murasaki after her illness and they exchange poems.

scene.content: 小侍従、人目を忍んで、柏木よりの文を、女三の宮にみせているところに源氏が戻ってくる。
scene.contenten: Koshosho, hiding from sight, is showing Kashiwagi's letter to the Third Princess when Genji returns.

scene.content: 源氏、女三の宮のもとで柏木よりの恋文を発見。小侍従慌てる。
scene.contenten: Genji discovers Kashiwagi's love letter at the Third Princess's; Koshosho panics.

summaryen: Following the grand women's concert at Rokujo-in, Murasaki falls critically ill under possession by Rokujo's vengeful spirit. While Genji nurses her at Nijo, Kashiwagi bribes a maid, violates Onna San no Miya, and leaves her pregnant. Discovering Kashiwagi's love letter, Genji is tormented by the karmic irony mirroring his own youthful sin against his father, mercilessly shaming Kashiwagi with subtle barbs at a banquet.

title: 柏木
summary: 新春、女三の宮は男児（薫）を出産するが、罪の呵責と恐怖に苛まれた柏木は衰弱死する。女三の宮は父・朱雀院の手で出家。源氏は薫を我が子として抱きながら因果の恐ろしさに涙する。臨終の柏木から妻・落葉の宮の後事を託された夕霧は、一条宮へ見舞いに通ううちに未亡人となった落葉の宮に心を奪われていく。
gendaibun: 女三の宮の御病気味であることについて、世間の噂もさまざまに取り沙汰され、内裏でもどのようにお聞きあそばされたのか、お気の毒にお思われになるお言葉を折々下されることがあった。
gendaibunen: Gossip spread regarding the Third Princess's failing condition; at the palace, the Emperor too heard whispers and sent frequent words of heartfelt concern.
kobun: 女三の宮の御事は、まして人の聞こえもゆゆしく、内裏にも、いかにと聞こし召したるにや、いとほしう思しのたまはするをりをりあり。
kobunen: Concerning the Third Princess, worldly whispers were increasingly ominous, and the Emperor himself, wondering how she fared, sent frequent inquiries full of pity.

scene.content: 重病の柏木、小侍従に紙燭をかかげさせ女三の宮は病床より降りて迎え、源氏もともに語り合う。
scene.contenten: The gravely ill Kashiwagi has Koshosho hold up a lamp; the Third Princess comes down from her sickbed to receive him, and Genji talks with them.

scene.content: 朱雀院、六条院に女三の宮を見舞う。女三の宮は病床より降りて迎え、源氏もともに語り合う。
scene.contenten: Emperor Suzaku visits the Third Princess at Rokujo-in; she comes down from her sickbed to receive him, and Genji talks with them as well.

scene.content: 夕霧、柏木を見舞う。柏木、後事を託す。
scene.contenten: Yugiri visits the ill Kashiwagi; Kashiwagi entrusts him with his affairs.

scene.content: 若君（薫）の五十日祝いを迎え、源氏幼児を抱いて感慨にふける。几帳を隔て尼姿の女三の宮。
scene.contenten: On the fiftieth-day celebration of the young lord (Kaoru), Genji holds the infant and muses; the Third Princess, in nun's habit, is beyond a screen.

scene.content: 夕霧、春の日に故柏木の妻、落葉の宮を一条宮に訪ね、応対に出た母御息女と語り合う、夕霧、涙を拭い鼻をかむ。
scene.contenten: On a spring day Yugiri visits the late Kashiwagi's wife, the Lady Ochiba, at Ichijo Palace, talks with her mother, and weeping, wipes his tears and blows his nose.

summaryen: Onna San no Miya gives birth to a boy, Kaoru, while Kashiwagi, crushed by guilt and dread of Genji, dies in despair. Overwhelmed by shame, Onna San no Miya takes vows under Suzaku's guidance. Genji cradles Kaoru at his fifty-day celebration, weeping over the inescapable wheel of karma. Meanwhile, Yugiri, entrusted with Kashiwagi's affairs, begins to fall in love with his friend's grieving widow, Ochiba no Miya.

title: 横笛
summary: 柏木の一周忌を終えた秋、落葉の宮の母・一条御息所は手厚い配慮への返礼として柏木遺愛の横笛を夕霧に贈る。その夜、夕霧の夢枕に柏木が現れ「その笛はあなたではなく然るべき人に伝えてほしい」と告げる。夕霧は六条院の源氏に夢と横笛のことを相談するが、笛の真の継承者が薫であることを知る源氏は言葉を濁して笛を手元に留める。
gendaibun: 故衛門督の一周忌の仏事も無事に営まれて、親しかった人々はますますその面影を恋しく思い出し、悲しみを新たにしていた。
gendaibunen: The first anniversary memorial service for the late Captain of the Gate passed quietly, leaving those who loved him in renewed sorrow as they fondly recalled his memory.
kobun: 故衛門督の一周忌の御事、過ぐして後、人々いとど面影恋しう、悲しきこと尽きせず思へり。
kobunen: When the first anniversary rites for the late Captain of the Gate had passed, people remembered him with boundless longing and fresh tears.

scene.content: 山の朱雀院より女三の宮に贈られた筍に添えられた文を源氏読む。
scene.contenten: Genji reads the letter attached to the bamboo shoots sent from the mountain Suzaku-in to the Third Princess.

scene.content: 幼い薫、這い出してきて、筍をとり口にいれたり投げ出したりするのを、源氏見て笑いたしなめる。
scene.contenten: Young Kaoru crawls out and puts the bamboo shoots in his mouth or tosses them about; Genji watches, laughing and admonishing him.

scene.content: 源氏、薫を膝に抱きとり、話しかけ、戯れに歌を詠む。
scene.contenten: Genji holds Kaoru on his knee, speaks to him, and playfully composes a poem.

scene.content: 秋、夕霧、落葉の宮を訪問、 想夫恋を合奏。帰りに一条御息所より柏木遺愛の笛を贈られ、試みに吹き鳴らす。
scene.contenten: In autumn Yugiri visits the Lady Ochiba and they play the piece So-shi-koi together; on leaving he is given Kashiwagi's beloved flute by the Ichijo Lady Mother and tries blowing it.

scene.content: 夜更けて帰邸した夕霧の夢に柏木現われ、笛は別人に贈るつもりであったという。
scene.contenten: In a dream of Yugiri, who has returned late at night, Kashiwagi appears and says the flute was meant for another.

scene.content: 雲居雁、夜中におびえて泣く幼児を抱く。 夕霧も起きて来る。
scene.contenten: Kumoi no Kari holds a crying infant frightened in the night; Yugiri also rises.

summaryen: Following Kashiwagi's first anniversary, Ochiba's mother presents Yugiri with Kashiwagi's treasured flute. That night Kashiwagi appears in Yugiri's dream, explaining that the instrument belongs to another. Yugiri consults Genji, who—realizing the true recipient must be Kashiwagi's secret son Kaoru—evades giving an explicit answer and holds the flute in trust.

title: 鈴虫
summary: 夏、尼となった女三の宮の持仏開眼供養が営まれる。十五夜の月明かりの下、源氏は女三の宮の庭に放たれた鈴虫の音を愛でながら管弦の宴を開き、冷泉院の招きを受けて夜更けまで語り合う。母・六条御息所の怨霊が成仏できずに苦しんでいることを知った秋好中宮は出家を願うが、源氏はこれを押し留め、手厚い法華八講を修して御息所の冥福を祈る。
gendaibun: 女三の宮の御持仏の開眼供養は、蓮の花の盛りのころに営まれた。御堂の飾り付けから仏具の調度に至るまで、源氏の大臣が心を尽くして整えられた。
gendaibunen: The consecration rites for the Third Princess's private chapel were held at the height of lotus bloom, arranged with utmost devotion by Lord Genji.
kobun: 女三の宮の御持仏供養は、蓮の花の盛りのころにし給ふ。御堂のしつらひ、仏具のよそほひ、大臣いと心ばへ深く調へさせたまへり。
kobunen: The dedication of the Third Princess's private altar was celebrated amid blooming lotuses, its sacred furnishings prepared with tender solicitude by the Minister.

scene.content: 蓮の花の盛りに女三の宮持仏供養。訪れてきた源氏、扇の蓮の花にかけた歌を書く。
scene.contenten: While the lotuses are in full bloom, the Third Princess makes an offering to her private Buddha; Genji, visiting, writes a poem on a lotus flower on a fan.
